from fetching import Handle, fetch


def test_fetch():
    handle = Handle()

cases.name: refused:test_round11_fixes.py:b8a74f5dca36
cases.source:
Round 11 review fix tests.

The red team rejected slice 12 on two Criticals of one kind.
A planting must never leave a tree the language refuses,
because the engine writes planted trees with no compile
check, so a broken planting scores as a catch against an
innocent gate. Seed-36 planted that breakage at the lone
handler standing beside both an else clause and a finally
block, and seed-34, landed in slice 11, already planted it
on a try and finally with no handler, the shape of its own
caught fixture, whose catch could not tell the defect from
the breakage. These tests pin the repairs and the invariant
behind them, that every seed's planting on the repo's own
corpus compiles.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo.

Slice 5 tests. Four new seeds and a versioned seed pack.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not

cases.source:
Tests for the slice 6 obligations in CONTRACT.md.

Slice 6 pins each seed pack version to the registry it names. The
loader refuses a pack whose ids are not exactly the id set of its
declared format version and a pack whose entries disagree with the
registry on a name or a defect class, while the description of an
entry stays unverified prose.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this test file.

"""Command line entry point for canaryfield."""

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from .engine import run_field
from .report import to_json, to_text
from .seedpack import SEED_PACK_FORMAT, write_seed_pack


def _parse_gate(text):
    name, separator, command = text.partition("=")
    if not separator or not name.strip() or not command.strip():
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
            f"gate must be written as NAME=COMMAND, got {text!r}"
        )
    return name.strip(), command.strip()


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="canaryfield",
        description="Plant seeded defects into scratch copies of a target "
        "tree and score which gates catch each one.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--target", help="target tree to copy and plant into")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--gate",
        action="append",
        type=_parse_gate,
        metavar="NAME=COMMAND",
        help="a named gate command, repeatable",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--plant",
        choices=("copy", "git-branches"),
        default="copy",
        help="planting mode, copy for scratch copies or git-branches for a scratch clone",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--write-seed-pack",
        metavar="PATH",
        help=f"write the {SEED_PACK_FORMAT} seed pack to PATH and exit",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--out", help="directory to write catch-table.txt and catch-table.json into")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="print the JSON report to stdout")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=120, help="per gate run timeout in seconds")
    parser.add_argument("--work-root", help="scratch directory root, defaults to a temp directory")
    parser.add_argument("--keep-scratch", action="store_true", help="keep the scratch copies after the run")
    return parser


def main(argv=None):
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.write_seed_pack:
        write_seed_pack(args.write_seed_pack)
        print(f"wrote {SEED_PACK_FORMAT} seed pack to {args.write_seed_pack}")
        return 0
    if not args.target or not args.gate:
        parser.error("--target and at least one --gate are required unless --write-seed-pack is used")
    try:
        result = run_field(
            args.target,
            args.gate,
            timeout=args.timeout,
            work_root=args.work_root,
            keep_scratch=args.keep_scratch,
            plant_mode=args.plant,
        )
    except ValueError as error:
        print(f"error, {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    if not result["target_unchanged"]:
        print("error, the target tree changed during the run", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    if args.out:
        out = Path(args.out)
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (out / "catch-table.txt").write_text(to_text(result), encoding="utf-8")
        (out / "catch-table.json").write_text(to_json(result), encoding="utf-8")
    print(to_json(result) if args.json else to_text(result), end="")
    return 0

"""The catch table, rendered as plain text and as JSON."""

import json


def to_json(result):
    return json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"


def to_text(result):
    gate_names = result["gates"]
    lines = []
    lines.append("canaryfield catch table")
    lines.append("=======================")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"target           {result['target']}")
    lines.append(f"target unchanged {str(result['target_unchanged']).lower()}")
    for name in gate_names:
        lines.append(f"clean exit for gate {name} is {result['clean_exits'][name]}")
    lines.append("")
    header = ["seed", "name", "planted file"] + gate_names
    rows = []
    for row in result["rows"]:
        rows.append(
            [row["seed"], row["name"], row["planted_file"] or "none"]
            + [row["gates"][name] for name in gate_names]
        )
    widths = [
        max(len(header[index]), *(len(row[index]) for row in rows))
        for index in range(len(header))
    ]

    def render(cells):
        return "  ".join(
            cell.ljust(widths[index]) for index, cell in enumerate(cells)
        ).rstrip()

    lines.append(render(header))
    lines.append(render(["-" * width for width in widths]))
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        lines.append(render(row))
        planted_files = result["rows"][index].get("planted_files") or []
        if len(planted_files) > 1:
            lines.append(f"  planted in {', '.join(planted_files)}")
    unparseable = result.get("unparseable_files") or []
    if unparseable:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(
            "files skipped as unparseable " + ", ".join(unparseable)
        )
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("summary per gate")
    for name in gate_names:
        counts = result["summary"][name]
        lines.append(
            f"  {name}  caught {counts['caught']}"
            f"  waved-through {counts['waved-through']}"
            f"  not-applicable {counts['not-applicable']}"
            f"  gate-broken {counts['gate-broken']}"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import (
    CAUGHT,
    GATE_BROKEN,
    NOT_APPLICABLE,
    WAVED,
    hash_tree,
    run_field,
)
from canaryfield.report import to_json, to_text

from fixture_project import GATE, write_main_project, write_tiny_project


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def main_run(tmp_path_factory):
    target = write_main_project(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("target") / "project")
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    return target, result


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def test_caught_and_waved_scoring(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run
    cells = _cells(result)
    for seed_id in (
        "seed-00",
        "seed-01",
        "seed-02",
        "seed-03",
        "seed-04",
        "seed-05",
        "seed-06",
        "seed-08",
        "seed-10",
        "seed-11",
        "seed-12",
        "seed-20",
        "seed-21",
    ):
        assert cells[seed_id] == CAUGHT, seed_id
    assert cells["seed-07"] == WAVED
    assert cells["seed-09"] == WAVED
    for seed_id in ("seed-13", "seed-14", "seed-15"):
        assert cells[seed_id] == NOT_APPLICABLE, seed_id


def test_gate_runs_on_clean_and_planted_copies(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    planted = 0
    for row in result["rows"]:
        if not row["planted_files"]:
            assert row["planted_file"] is None
            continue
        planted += 1
        assert row["planted_file"] == "sample.py"
        assert row["planted_exits"]["tests"] is not None
    assert planted == 17


def test_catch_table_shape_and_statuses(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run
    # Slice 14 registry growth, 44 to 48 seeds under canaryfield-seeds/10.
    assert len(result["rows"]) == 48
    allowed = {CAUGHT, WAVED, NOT_APPLICABLE, GATE_BROKEN}
    for row in result["rows"]:
        assert set(row["gates"].values()) <= allowed
    summary = result["summary"]["tests"]
    assert summary[CAUGHT] == 14
    assert summary[WAVED] == 3
    # The four slice 14 seeds do not apply to the demo project, 27 to 31.
    assert summary[NOT_APPLICABLE] == 31
    assert summary[GATE_BROKEN] == 0


def test_report_renders_text_and_json_with_the_same_facts(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run
    text = to_text(result)
    rendered_json = to_json(result)
    assert "canaryfield catch table" in text
    assert "seed-07" in text and WAVED in text
    assert '"seed-07"' in rendered_json and WAVED in rendered_json
    assert result["summary"]["tests"][CAUGHT] == 14


def test_target_tree_is_byte_identical_after_a_run(tmp_path):
    target = write_main_project(tmp_path / "project")
    before = hash_tree(target)
    result = run_field(target, [("noop", "true")], timeout=30)
    after = hash_tree(target)
    assert before == after
    assert result["target_unchanged"] is True


def test_inapplicable_seed_is_recorded_not_applicable(tmp_path):
    target = write_tiny_project(tmp_path / "tiny")
    result = run_field(target, [("noop", "true")], timeout=30)
    cells = {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["noop"] for row in result["rows"]}
    assert cells["seed-00"] == NOT_APPLICABLE
    assert cells["seed-04"] == NOT_APPLICABLE
    assert cells["seed-05"] == NOT_APPLICABLE
    assert result["rows"][0]["planted_file"] is None


def test_gate_failing_on_clean_copy_is_broken(tmp_path):
    target = write_main_project(tmp_path / "project")
    broken_gate = ("broken", "python3 -c \"import sys; sys.exit(3)\"")
    result = run_field(target, [broken_gate], timeout=30)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["broken"] == 3
    for row in result["rows"]:
        expected = GATE_BROKEN if row["planted_file"] else NOT_APPLICABLE
        assert row["gates"]["broken"] == expected
    assert result["summary"]["broken"][CAUGHT] == 0
    assert result["summary"]["broken"][GATE_BROKEN] == 17

@pytest.fixture(scope='module')
def main_run(tmp_path_factory):
    target = write_main_project(tmp_path_factory.mktemp('target') / 'project')
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    return (target, result)

def _cells(result):
    return {row['seed']: row['gates']['tests'] for row in result['rows']}

def test_caught_and_waved_scoring(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run
    cells = _cells(result)
    for seed_id in ('seed-00', 'seed-01', 'seed-02', 'seed-03', 'seed-04', 'seed-05', 'seed-06', 'seed-08', 'seed-10', 'seed-11', 'seed-12', 'seed-20', 'seed-21'):

    assert cells['seed-07'] == WAVED
    assert cells['seed-09'] == WAVED
    for seed_id in ('seed-13', 'seed-14', 'seed-15'):
        assert cells[seed_id] == NOT_APPLICABLE, seed_id

def test_gate_runs_on_clean_and_planted_copies(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run
    assert result['clean_exits']['tests'] == 0

        if not row['planted_files']:
            assert row['planted_file'] is None
            continue
        planted += 1
        assert row['planted_file'] == 'sample.py'
        assert row['planted_exits']['tests'] is not None
    assert planted == 17

def test_catch_table_shape_and_statuses(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run
    assert len(result['rows']) == 48
    allowed = {CAUGHT, WAVED, NOT_APPLICABLE, GATE_BROKEN}
    for row in result['rows']:
        assert set(row['gates'].values()) <= allowed
    summary = result['summary']['tests']
    assert summary[CAUGHT] == 14
    assert summary[WAVED] == 3
    assert summary[NOT_APPLICABLE] == 31
    assert summary[GATE_BROKEN] == 0

def test_report_renders_text_and_json_with_the_same_facts(main_run):
    _target, result = main_run

    assert result['summary']['tests'][CAUGHT] == 14

def test_inapplicable_seed_is_recorded_not_applicable(tmp_path):

def test_gate_failing_on_clean_copy_is_broken(tmp_path):

    assert cells['seed-04'] == NOT_APPLICABLE
    assert cells['seed-05'] == NOT_APPLICABLE
    assert result['rows'][0]['planted_file'] is None

def test_gate_failing_on_clean_copy_is_broken(tmp_path):
    target = write_main_project(tmp_path / 'project')
    broken_gate = ('broken', 'python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(3)"')
    result = run_field(target, [broken_gate])
    assert result['clean_exits']['broken'] == 3
    for row in result['rows']:
        expected = GATE_BROKEN if row['planted_file'] else NOT_APPLICABLE
        assert row['gates']['broken'] == expected
    assert result['summary']['broken'][CAUGHT] == 0
    assert result['summary']['broken'][GATE_BROKEN] == 17

cases.source:
"""Round 11 review fix tests.

The red team rejected slice 12 on two Criticals of one kind.
A planting must never leave a tree the language refuses,
because the engine writes planted trees with no compile
check, so a broken planting scores as a catch against an
innocent gate. Seed-36 planted that breakage at the lone
handler standing beside both an else clause and a finally
block, and seed-34, landed in slice 11, already planted it
on a try and finally with no handler, the shape of its own
caught fixture, whose catch could not tell the defect from
the breakage. These tests pin the repairs and the invariant
behind them, that every seed's planting on the repo's own
corpus compiles.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo.
"""

import ast
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, plant_seed, run_field
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

FETCH_SOURCE = """\
class Handle:
    def __init__(self):
        self.closed = False

    def read(self):
        return "data"

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True


def fetch(handle):
    try:
        return handle.read()
    finally:
        handle.close()
"""

FETCH_TEST = """\
from fetching import Handle, fetch


def test_fetch_closes_the_handle():
    handle = Handle()
    assert fetch(handle) == "data"
    assert handle.closed is True
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        (root / name).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {
        row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"]
        for row in result["rows"]
    }


def test_seed_thirty_six_refuses_a_lone_handler_beside_an_else_and_a_finally():
    source = (
        "def parse(text):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return int(text)\n"
        "    except ValueError:\n"
        "        return -1\n"
        "    else:\n"
        "        return 0\n"
        "    finally:\n"
        "        pass\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-36"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_thirty_six_refuses_the_star_form_of_the_conjunction():
    source = (
        "def parse(text):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return int(text)\n"
        "    except* ValueError:\n"
        "        return -1\n"
        "    else:\n"
        "        return 0\n"
        "    finally:\n"
        "        pass\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-36"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_thirty_four_plants_a_handlerless_finally_as_a_pass_body():
    tree = ast.parse(FETCH_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-34"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "finally:" in rendered
    assert "handle.close()" not in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_four_still_removes_the_block_beside_handlers():
    source = (
        "def fetch(handle):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return handle.read()\n"
        "    except OSError:\n"
        "        return 'gone'\n"
        "    finally:\n"
        "        handle.close()\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-34"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "finally:" not in rendered
    assert "except OSError:" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_four_catch_is_earned_on_a_compiling_copy(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"fetching.py": FETCH_SOURCE, "test_fetching.py": FETCH_TEST},
    )
    planted = tmp_path / "planted"

"""Round 12 review fix pins for the slice 13 obligations.

The two axis review and the red team returned the same three
record gaps at the edges of the new seeds, and two further
edges with no pin. The behaviour at every one of them already
conformed under the reviewers own probes, and the pins below
hold the readings the Round 12 review fixes section of
CONTRACT.md states. Every fixture here is synthetic.
"""

import ast

from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID


def _planted(seed_id, source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    applied = SEEDS_BY_ID[seed_id].apply(tree)
    return applied, tree


def test_seed_forty_and_seed_three_plant_the_same_tree_on_a_returned_start_only_slice():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return items[1:]\n"
    applied40, tree40 = _planted("seed-40", source)
    applied03, tree03 = _planted("seed-03", source)
    assert applied40 and applied03
    assert ast.dump(tree40) == ast.dump(tree03)
    assert "items[2:]" in ast.unparse(tree40)


def test_seed_forty_and_seed_three_plant_the_same_tree_on_a_compared_start_only_slice():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return items[1:] == probe\n"
    applied40, tree40 = _planted("seed-40", source)
    applied03, tree03 = _planted("seed-03", source)
    assert applied40 and applied03
    assert ast.dump(tree40) == ast.dump(tree03)


def test_seed_forty_and_seed_three_diverge_where_a_stop_stands():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return items[1:4]\n"
    _, tree40 = _planted("seed-40", source)
    _, tree03 = _planted("seed-03", source)
    assert "items[2:4]" in ast.unparse(tree40)
    assert "items[2:5]" in ast.unparse(tree03)
    assert ast.dump(tree40) != ast.dump(tree03)


def test_seed_forty_one_never_plants_a_continue_in_a_loop_else_clause():
    source = (
        "def f(items):\n"
        "    for item in items:\n"
        "        pass\n"
        "    else:\n"
        "        continue\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-41", source)
    assert not applied
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_one_never_plants_a_continue_in_an_inner_loops_else_clause():
    source = (
        "def f(items):\n"
        "    for item in items:\n"
        "        for other in items:\n"
        "            pass\n"
        "        else:\n"
        "            continue\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-41", source)
    assert not applied
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_three_never_plants_an_augmented_assignment():
    source = "pair += (1, 2)\n"
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-43", source)
    assert not applied
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_two_refuses_a_declaration_only_handler_body():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        pass\n"
        "    except ValueError:\n"
        "        global x\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-42", source)
    assert not applied
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_two_plants_a_declaration_beside_a_statement_in_a_handler_body():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        pass\n"
        "    except ValueError:\n"
        "        global x\n"
        "        y = 1\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-42", source)
    assert applied
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "global x" not in rendered
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")


def test_seed_forty_two_refuses_a_declaration_only_finally_body():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        pass\n"
        "    finally:\n"
        "        global x\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-42", source)
    assert not applied
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_three_swaps_a_named_expression_standing_first():
    source = "pair = ((x := 1), 2)\n"
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-43", source)
    assert applied
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert rendered == "pair = (2, (x := 1))"
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")


def test_seed_forty_three_swaps_a_named_expression_standing_second():
    source = "pair = (2, (x := 1))\n"
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-43", source)
    assert applied
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert rendered == "pair = ((x := 1), 2)"
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")


def test_seed_forty_and_seed_three_part_on_a_tuple_sibling_constant():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return (0, items[1:])\n"
    _, tree40 = _planted("seed-40", source)
    _, tree03 = _planted("seed-03", source)
    assert "(0, items[2:])" in ast.unparse(tree40)
    assert "(1, items[2:])" in ast.unparse(tree03)
    assert ast.dump(tree40) != ast.dump(tree03)


def test_seed_forty_and_seed_three_plant_the_same_tree_on_a_call_argument_inside_a_return():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return len(items[1:])\n"
    applied40, tree40 = _planted("seed-40", source)
    applied03, tree03 = _planted("seed-03", source)
    assert applied40 and applied03
    assert ast.dump(tree40) == ast.dump(tree03)
    assert "len(items[2:])" in ast.unparse(tree40)

"""Round 13 review fix pins for the slice 14 obligations.

The red team returned one Major and two Minors against the new
seeds. Seed-47 planted a negation standing in the guard of a
match case, ground R-5 gives to the seeds that own condition
tests, and seed-46 negated two zero spellings of a range step
into themselves where R-4 excludes a zero step for changing
nothing. The pins below hold the readings the Round 13 review
fixes section of CONTRACT.md states. Every fixture here is
synthetic.
"""

import ast

from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID


def _planted(seed_id, source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    applied = SEEDS_BY_ID[seed_id].apply(tree)
    return applied, tree


def test_seed_forty_seven_never_plants_a_negation_in_a_match_guard():
    source = (
        "def f(item):\n"
        "    match item:\n"
        "        case _ if not item.ready:\n"
        "            return 1\n"
        "        case _:\n"
        "            return 0\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-47", source)
    assert not applied
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_seven_never_plants_a_negation_in_a_nested_match_guard():
    source = (
        "def f(item):\n"
        "    match item:\n"
        "        case [inner]:\n"
        "            match inner:\n"
        "                case _ if not inner.ready:\n"
        "                    return 1\n"
        "    return 0\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-47", source)
    assert not applied
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_seven_plants_outside_a_match_while_its_guard_negation_stands():
    source = (
        "def f(item):\n"
        "    match item:\n"
        "        case _ if not item.ready:\n"
        "            return 1\n"
        "    return not item.done\n"
    )
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-47", source)
    assert applied
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "not item.ready" in rendered
    assert "return item.done" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_six_never_plants_a_zero_step_in_any_literal_spelling():
    for step in ("0.0", "+0", "+0.0", "0j"):
        source = f"def f():\n    return range(0, 10, {step})\n"
        applied, tree = _planted("seed-46", source)
        assert not applied, step
        assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source)), step


def test_seed_forty_six_still_plants_a_nonzero_float_step():
    source = "def f():\n    return range(0, 10, 0.5)\n"
    applied, tree = _planted("seed-46", source)
    assert applied
    assert "-0.5" in ast.unparse(tree)

from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data, write_seed_pack
from fixture_project import GATE, write_main_project, write_tiny_project

def _git(cwd, *arguments):
    completed = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(cwd)] + list(arguments), capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert completed.returncode == 1, completed.stderr
    return completed.stdout.strip()

def _write_git_project(root):
    _git(root, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main')
    _git(root, 'add', '-A')
    _git(root, '-c', 'user.name=Fixture', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'Initial fixture commit')
    return root

def test_nonempty_work_root_is_refused_and_left_intact(tmp_path):
    target = write_tiny_project(tmp_path / 'project')
    work = tmp_path / 'work'
    work.mkdir()
    sentinel = work / 'operator-file.txt'
    sentinel.write_text('keep me', encoding='utf-8')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='not empty'):
        run_field(target, [GATE], work_root=work, timeout=60)
    assert sentinel.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == 'keep me'
    assert [entry.name for entry in work.iterdir()] == ['operator-file.txt']

def test_failed_run_never_deletes_a_previously_kept_clone(tmp_path):
    target = _write_git_project(write_main_project(tmp_path / 'project'))
    work = tmp_path / 'work'
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], work_root=work, keep_scratch=True, plant_mode='git-branches', timeout=60)
    kept_clone = work / 'clone'
    assert kept_clone.is_dir()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='not empty'):
        run_field(target, [GATE], work_root=work, plant_mode='git-branches', timeout=60)
    assert kept_clone.is_dir()
    branches = _git(kept_clone, 'branch', '--format=%(refname:short)').splitlines()
    assert 'canaryfield/seed-00' in branches

def test_git_mode_survives_a_gate_that_writes_a_tracked_file(tmp_path):
    target = _write_git_project(write_main_project(tmp_path / 'project'))
    writing_gate = ('writer', "printf 'noise\\n' >> sample.py; true")
    result = run_field(target, [writing_gate], plant_mode='git-branches', timeout=60)
    assert len(result['rows']) == 49
    assert result['target_unchanged'] is True

def test_git_mode_refuses_a_subdirectory_of_a_repo(tmp_path):
    repo = _write_git_project(write_main_project(tmp_path / 'project'))
    nested = repo / 'examples'
    nested.mkdir()
    (nested / 'note.txt').write_text('nested', encoding='utf-8')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='not the root'):
        run_field(nested, [GATE], plant_mode='git-branches', timeout=60)

def test_git_mode_refuses_a_repo_with_no_commits(tmp_path):
    empty = tmp_path / 'empty'
    empty.mkdir()
    _git(empty, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='no commits'):
        run_field(empty, [GATE], plant_mode='git-branches', timeout=60)

def test_cli_refusal_is_an_error_line_not_a_traceback(tmp_path, capsys):
    target = write_tiny_project(tmp_path / 'plain')
    code = cli_main(['--target', str(target), '--gate', 'g=true', '--plant', 'git-branches'])
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert code == 3
    assert 'Traceback' not in captured.err
    assert 'not a git repository' in captured.err

def _pack_with(tmp_path, mutate):
    data = seed_pack_data()
    mutate(data)
    path = tmp_path / 'pack.json'
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding='utf-8')
    return path

def test_seed_pack_rejects_a_duplicate_id(tmp_path):

    def mutate(data):
        data['seeds'][1]['id'] = data['seeds'][0]['id']

        load_seed_pack(_pack_with(tmp_path, mutate))

def test_seed_pack_rejects_a_numeric_id(tmp_path):

        data['seeds'][0]['id'] = 7
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='non empty piece of text'):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_with(tmp_path, mutate))

"""Tests for the Round 2 review fix obligations in CONTRACT.md.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this test file.
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import NOT_APPLICABLE, _is_test_file, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID

from test_slice3 import NOOP_GATE, _git, _write_git_project

needs_symlink = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not hasattr(os, "symlink"), reason="platform cannot create symlinks"
)

MODULE = (
    "def value():\n"
    "    return 7\n"
)

TEST_FOR_MODULE = (
    "from mod import value\n"
    "\n"
    "\n"
    "def test_value():\n"
    "    assert value() == 7\n"
)

PYTEST_GATE = ("tests", "python3 -m pytest -q")


def _rows(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row for row in result["rows"]}


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


@needs_symlink
def test_git_mode_never_writes_through_a_committed_symlink(tmp_path):
    outside = tmp_path / "outside.py"
    outside.write_text(MODULE, encoding="utf-8")
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"mod.py": MODULE, "test_mod.py": TEST_FOR_MODULE},
    )
    os.symlink(outside, target / "escape.py")
    _write_git_project(target)
    result = run_field(
        target,
        [PYTEST_GATE],
        timeout=60,
        work_root=tmp_path / "work",
        plant_mode="git-branches",
    )
    assert outside.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == MODULE
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["mod.py"]
    assert result["target_unchanged"] is True


@needs_symlink
def test_a_relative_symlink_is_not_a_second_planting(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"real.py": MODULE, "test_mod.py": TEST_FOR_MODULE},
    )
    (target / "test_mod.py").write_text(
        "from real import value\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def test_value():\n"
        "    assert value() == 7\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    os.symlink("real.py", target / "linked.py")
    _write_git_project(target)
    work_root = tmp_path / "work"
    result = run_field(
        target,
        [NOOP_GATE],
        timeout=30,
        work_root=work_root,
        keep_scratch=True,
        plant_mode="git-branches",
    )
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["real.py"]
    committed = _git(
        work_root / "clone",
        "show",
        "--name-only",
        "--format=",
        "canaryfield/seed-01",
    )
    assert committed.splitlines() == ["real.py"]


def test_an_identity_rewrite_is_not_a_planting(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {
            "version.py": "VERSION = '9.9.9'\n",
            "test_version.py": (
                "from version import VERSION\n"
                "\n"
                "\n"
                "def test_version():\n"
                "    assert VERSION == '9.9.9'\n"
            ),
        },
    )
    result = run_field(target, [PYTEST_GATE], timeout=60)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-00"]["planted_files"] == []
    assert rows["seed-00"]["gates"]["tests"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_git_mode_survives_an_identity_only_target(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {
            "version.py": "VERSION = '9.9.9'\n",
            "test_version.py": (
                "from version import VERSION\n"
                "\n"
                "\n"
                "def test_version():\n"
                "    assert VERSION == '9.9.9'\n"
            ),
        },
    )
    _write_git_project(target)
    result = run_field(
        target,
        [NOOP_GATE],
        timeout=30,
        work_root=tmp_path / "work",
        plant_mode="git-branches",
    )
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-00"]["planted_files"] == []
    assert rows["seed-00"]["branch"] is None


def test_test_infrastructure_is_never_planted(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {
            "mod.py": "def ready():\n    return 'yes'\n",
            "conftest.py": (
                "import pytest\n"
                "\n"
                "FLAG = True\n"
                "\n"
                "\n"
                "@pytest.fixture\n"
                "def flag():\n"
                "    return FLAG\n"
            ),
            "test_mod.py": (
                "from mod import ready\n"
                "\n"
                "\n"
                "def test_ready(flag):\n"
                "    assert ready() == 'yes'\n"
                "    assert flag is True\n"
            ),
        },
    )
    result = run_field(target, [PYTEST_GATE], timeout=60)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-05"]["planted_files"] == []
    assert rows["seed-05"]["gates"]["tests"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_the_test_file_test_covers_the_wider_surface():
    assert _is_test_file(Path("conftest.py"))
    assert _is_test_file(Path("test.py"))
    assert _is_test_file(Path("test/helper.py"))
    assert _is_test_file(Path("testing/helper.py"))
    assert not _is_test_file(Path("src/helper.py"))


def test_one_unparseable_file_costs_no_run(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {
            "mod.py": MODULE,
            "broken.py": "def broken(:\n    return 1\n",
            "test_mod.py": TEST_FOR_MODULE,
        },
    )
    result = run_field(target, [PYTEST_GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["unparseable_files"] == ["broken.py"]
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["mod.py"]
    assert rows["seed-01"]["gates"]["tests"] == "caught"


def test_planted_files_sort_as_rendered_strings(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {
            "mod.py": MODULE,
            "mod/x.py": MODULE,
            "test_mod.py": TEST_FOR_MODULE,
        },
    )
    result = run_field(target, [NOOP_GATE], timeout=30)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["mod.py", "mod/x.py"]


def test_a_whitespace_only_pack_field_is_refused(tmp_path):
    entries = []
    for seed in sorted(SEEDS_BY_ID.values(), key=lambda item: item.id)[:12]:
        entries.append(
            {
                "id": seed.id,
                "name": seed.name,
                "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
                "description": seed.description,
            }
        )
    entries[0]["description"] = "   "
    pack = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    import json

    pack.write_text(
        json.dumps({"format": "canaryfield-seeds/1", "seeds": entries}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        load_seed_pack(pack)

"""Tests for the Round 3 review fix obligations in CONTRACT.md.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this test file.
The red team probes are ported here as regression tests. Copy
mode symlink behaviour is pinned here because the Round 2 tests
pinned it only in git mode.
"""

import os
import sys

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field

needs_symlink = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not hasattr(os, "symlink"), reason="platform cannot create symlinks"
)

GATE = (
    sys.executable + " -m pytest -q tests/test_mod.py -p no:cacheprovider"
)


def _write_project(root, module_text, test_text=None):
    (root / "tests").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "mod.py").write_text(module_text, encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "tests" / "test_mod.py").write_text(
        test_text
        or "from mod import value\n\n\ndef test_value():\n    assert value() == 1\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return root


def _row(result, seed_id):
    return next(r for r in result["rows"] if r["seed"] == seed_id)


@needs_symlink
def test_copy_mode_never_plants_through_a_symlink_alias(tmp_path):
    root = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "proj", "def value():\n    return 1\n"
    )
    os.symlink("mod.py", root / "alias.py")
    result = run_field(root, [("gate", GATE)])
    row = _row(result, "seed-01")
    assert row["planted_files"] == ["mod.py"]


@needs_symlink
def test_copy_mode_never_plants_a_file_outside_the_target(tmp_path):
    outside = tmp_path / "outside.py"
    outside.write_text("def value():\n    return 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    before = outside.read_bytes()
    root = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "proj", "def value():\n    return 1\n"
    )
    os.symlink(outside, root / "linked.py")
    result = run_field(root, [("gate", GATE)])
    row = _row(result, "seed-01")
    assert "linked.py" not in row["planted_files"]
    assert outside.read_bytes() == before


def test_seed_eleven_judges_a_return_against_its_own_function(tmp_path):
    module = (
        "def outer(a, b):\n"
        "    def inner(c):\n"
        "        return c\n"
        "    return inner(a)\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def value():\n"
        "    return 1\n"
    )
    root = _write_project(tmp_path / "proj", module)
    result = run_field(root, [("gate", GATE)])
    row = _row(result, "seed-11")
    assert row["gates"]["gate"] == NOT_APPLICABLE
    assert row["planted_files"] == []


def test_seed_eleven_plants_a_nested_function_on_its_own_params(tmp_path):
    module = (
        "def outer():\n"
        "    def inner(a, b):\n"
        "        return a\n"
        "    return inner(1, 2)\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def value():\n"
        "    return outer()\n"
    )
    test_text = (
        "from mod import value\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def test_value():\n"
        "    assert value() == 1\n"
    )
    root = _write_project(tmp_path / "proj", module, test_text)
    result = run_field(root, [("gate", GATE)])
    row = _row(result, "seed-11")
    assert row["planted_files"] == ["mod.py"]


def test_seed_zero_four_plants_past_an_already_swallowed_handler(
    tmp_path,
):
    module = (
        "def first():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        raise ValueError('boom')\n"
        "    except Exception:\n"
        "        pass\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def second():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        raise ValueError('boom')\n"
        "    except Exception:\n"
        "        return 2\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def value():\n"
        "    return second()\n"
    )
    test_text = (
        "from mod import value\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def test_value():\n"
        "    assert value() == 2\n"
    )
    root = _write_project(tmp_path / "proj", module, test_text)
    result = run_field(root, [("gate", GATE)])
    row = _row(result, "seed-04")
    assert row["planted_files"] == ["mod.py"]
    assert row["gates"]["gate"] == "caught"

        "def either(flag, other):\n"

"""Tests for the Round 6 review fixes in CONTRACT.md.

FIX6-1 keeps seed-16 off a handler whose type names a broad
base in any member, bare or inside a tuple. FIX6-2 counts
seed-19 parameters in signature declaration order. The scope
rules of K-5 and the conditional expression shape of K-4 gain
the discriminating pins the two axis review found missing.
"""

import ast

from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID


def _rendered(seed_id, source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    applied = SEEDS_BY_ID[seed_id].apply(tree)
    return applied, ast.unparse(tree)


def test_seed_sixteen_skips_a_tuple_naming_exception():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return 1\n"
        "    except (ValueError, Exception):\n"
        "        return -1\n"
    )
    applied, _rendered_text = _rendered("seed-16", source)
    assert applied is False


def test_seed_sixteen_skips_a_tuple_naming_base_exception():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return 1\n"
        "    except (BaseException, ValueError):\n"
        "        return -1\n"
    )
    applied, _rendered_text = _rendered("seed-16", source)
    assert applied is False


def test_seed_sixteen_widens_a_tuple_of_narrow_types():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return 1\n"
        "    except (ValueError, TypeError):\n"
        "        return -1\n"
    )
    applied, rendered = _rendered("seed-16", source)
    assert applied is True
    assert "except Exception" in rendered
    assert "ValueError" not in rendered


def test_seed_nineteen_parameters_follow_signature_order():
    source = (
        "def run(first, *rest, flag):\n"
        "    for first in items:\n"
        "        pass\n"
    )
    applied, rendered = _rendered("seed-19", source)
    assert applied is True
    assert "for rest in items" in rendered


def test_seed_nineteen_stays_inside_the_inner_scope():
    source = (
        "def outer(outer_name):\n"
        "    def inner():\n"
        "        total = 0\n"
        "        for item in items:\n"
        "            total += item\n"
        "        return total\n"
        "    return inner\n"
    )
    applied, rendered = _rendered("seed-19", source)
    assert applied is True
    assert "for total in items" in rendered
    assert "for outer_name in items" not in rendered


def test_seed_nineteen_parameters_come_before_body_names():
    source = (
        "def f(param, items):\n"
        "    helper = 0\n"
        "    for item in items:\n"
        "        pass\n"
    )
    applied, rendered = _rendered("seed-19", source)
    assert applied is True
    assert "for param in items" in rendered


def test_seed_nineteen_ignores_a_comprehension_target():
    source = "for item in [y for y in range(3)]:\n    pass\n"
    applied, _rendered_text = _rendered("seed-19", source)
    assert applied is False


def test_seed_nineteen_ignores_a_walrus_inside_a_comprehension():
    source = "for item in [(w := v) for v in range(3)]:\n    pass\n"
    applied, _rendered_text = _rendered("seed-19", source)
    assert applied is False


def test_seed_eighteen_strips_a_negated_conditional_expression():
    source = "def pick(flag):\n    return 1 if not flag else 2\n"
    applied, rendered = _rendered("seed-18", source)
    assert applied is True
    assert "1 if flag else 2" in rendered
    assert "not flag" not in rendered

"""Tests for the Round 7 review fixes in CONTRACT.md.

Four edge rules of slice 8 gain the discriminating content
level pins the two axis review found missing, the first two
arguments only rule of L-2 past two arguments, the empty
string and bytes exclusions of L-3, and the positive half of
the corrected nested function sentence of L-5.
"""

import ast

from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID


def _rendered(seed_id, source):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    applied = SEEDS_BY_ID[seed_id].apply(tree)
    return applied, ast.unparse(tree)


def test_seed_twenty_leaves_a_third_argument_standing():
    applied, rendered = _rendered(
        "seed-20", "result = combine(one, two, three)\n"
    )
    assert applied is True
    assert "combine(two, one, three)" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_one_leaves_an_empty_string_standing():
    applied, rendered = _rendered(
        "seed-21", "a = ''\nb = 'ready'\n"
    )
    assert applied is True
    assert "''" in rendered
    assert "'xeady'" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_one_leaves_a_bytes_literal_standing():
    applied, rendered = _rendered(
        "seed-21", "a = b'ready'\nb = 'ready'\n"
    )
    assert applied is True
    assert "b'ready'" in rendered
    assert "'xeady'" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_three_plants_a_break_in_a_nested_functions_loop():
    source = (
        "for outer in items:\n"
        "    def helper():\n"
        "        for inner in items:\n"
        "            break\n"
        "    helper()\n"
    )
    applied, rendered = _rendered("seed-23", source)
    assert applied is True
    assert "continue" in rendered
    assert "break" not in rendered

"""Tests for the Round 9 review fixes in CONTRACT.md.

A nested definition's header expressions stand in the
enclosing scope and are judged there, and a store or a load
standing inside a comprehension counts in the scope that
holds the comprehension.
"""

import ast

from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID


def test_seed_thirty_one_reads_a_nested_default_in_the_enclosing_scope():
    source = (
        "def outer(cfg):\n"
        "    first = cfg.alpha\n"
        "    def inner(value=cfg.beta):\n"
        "        return value\n"
        "    return first\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-31"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "first = cfg.beta" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_one_never_plants_on_nested_scope_evidence():
    source = (
        "def outer():\n"
        "    def inner(value=cfg.alpha):\n"
        "        cfg = build()\n"
        "        return cfg.beta\n"
        "    return inner\n"
    )

from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import SAMPLE_SOURCE


def test_registry_has_forty_eight_unique_seeds():
    assert len(SEEDS) == 48
    ids = [seed.id for seed in SEEDS]
    assert len(set(ids)) == 48
    assert ids == [f"seed-{index:02d}" for index in range(48)]

    tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert '"9.9.9"' in rendered or "'9.9.9'" in rendered
    assert "1.4.2" not in rendered

    for seed in SEEDS:
        assert seed.name.strip(), seed.id
        assert seed.defect_class.strip(), seed.id
        tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
        assert isinstance(seed.apply(tree), bool), seed.id

    # The main fixture was built for the original twelve seeds and
    # also exercises seed-12 through the division in safe_div and
    # seed-16 through the handler in safe_div and seed-20 through
    # the greet call in banner and seed-21 through its plain string
    # literals and seed-28 through the raise in safe_div. The
    # remaining slice 5 and slice 7 and slice 8 and slice 9 and
    # slice 10 and slice 11 seeds carry their own fixtures in
    # test_slice5.py and test_slice7.py and test_slice8.py and
    # test_slice9.py and test_slice10.py and test_slice11.py,
    # because this fixture holds no else branch, no compound
    # condition, no await, no dictionary literal, no while loop or
    # negated test, no for loop, no unary minus, no break statement,
    # no augmented assignment, no identity comparison, no subscript,
    # no numeric default, no attribute load, no call carrying
    # keyword arguments, no broad exception handler, no finally
    # block, no decorator, and no definition carrying a second
    # argument default. The slice 12 seeds carry their own
    # fixtures in test_slice12.py, because this fixture holds no
    # try statement a dropped handler could plant on, no yield,
    # and no class definition. The slice 13 seeds carry their own
    # fixtures in test_slice13.py, because this fixture holds no
    # slice, no loop a reversed control could plant on, no scope
    # declaration, and no tuple valued assignment. The slice 14
    # seeds carry their own fixtures in test_slice14.py, because
    # this fixture holds no loop else clause, no call carrying a
    # keyword argument, no three argument range call, and no
    # negation standing outside a condition test.
    applied = []
    for seed in SEEDS:
        tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
        if seed.apply(tree):
            applied.append(seed.id)
    assert applied == [seed.id for seed in SEEDS[:13]] + ["seed-16", "seed-20", "seed-21", "seed-28"]

    applied = []

        tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
        if seed.apply(tree):
            applied.append(seed.id)
    assert applied == [seed.id for seed in SEEDS[:13]] + ['seed-20', 'seed-21', 'seed-28']

import ast
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID
from fixture_project import SAMPLE_SOURCE

def test_registry_has_forty_eight_unique_seeds():
    assert len(SEEDS) == 48
    ids = [seed.id for seed in SEEDS]
    assert len(set(ids)) == 48
    assert ids == [f'seed-{index:02d}' for index in range(48)]

def test_seed_zero_is_the_stale_version_string():
    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID['seed-00']
    tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert '"9.9.9"' in rendered or "'9.9.9'" in rendered
    assert '1.4.2' not in rendered

def test_seed_metadata_is_complete():
    for seed in SEEDS:
        assert seed.name.strip(), seed.id
        assert seed.defect_class.strip(), seed.id
        tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
        assert isinstance(bool, seed.apply(tree)), seed.id

def test_main_fixture_applies_the_seeds_it_covers():
    applied = []
    for seed in SEEDS:
        tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
        if seed.apply(tree):
            applied.append(seed.id)
    assert applied == [seed.id for seed in SEEDS[:13]] + ['seed-16', 'seed-20', 'seed-21', 'seed-28']

import ast
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID
from fixture_project import SAMPLE_SOURCE

def test_registry_has_forty_eight_unique_seeds():
    assert len(SEEDS) == 48
    ids = [seed.id for seed in SEEDS]
    assert len(set(ids)) == 48
    assert ids == [f'seed-{index:02d}' for index in range(48)]

def test_seed_zero_is_the_stale_version_string():
    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID['seed-00']
    tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert '"9.9.9"' in rendered or "'9.9.9'" in rendered
    assert '1.4.2' not in rendered

def test_seed_metadata_is_complete():
    for seed in SEEDS:
        assert seed.id.strip(), seed.id
        assert seed.defect_class.strip(), seed.id
        tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
        assert isinstance(seed.apply(tree), bool), seed.id

def test_main_fixture_applies_the_seeds_it_covers():
    applied = []
    for seed in SEEDS:
        tree = ast.parse(SAMPLE_SOURCE)
        if seed.apply(tree):
            applied.append(seed.id)
    assert applied == [seed.id for seed in SEEDS[:13]] + ['seed-16', 'seed-20', 'seed-21', 'seed-28']

from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def test_seed_files_present():
    readme = (ROOT / "README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "## What this is" in readme
    assert "## Licence" in readme
    assert "MIT" in (ROOT / "LICENSE").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "__pycache__/" in (ROOT / ".gitignore").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_readme_status_is_honest():
    readme = (ROOT / "README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    status = readme.split("## Status", 1)[1].split("## Licence", 1)[0]
    # The closed round count below moves only at a round closure,
    # together with the README line it pins.
    for phrase in (
        "local seed is done",
        "403",
        "CONTRACT.md",
        "14 of 100",
        "AGENTS.md",
        "canonical template",
        "synthetic",
        "numbers only",
    ):
        assert phrase in status, phrase


def test_ci_runs_the_local_gate():
    workflow = (ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "python -m pytest" in workflow
    assert "push" in workflow
    assert "pull_request" in workflow


def test_agents_md_stands_from_the_canonical_template():
    agents = (ROOT / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "<!-- repo annex below this line -->" in agents
    assert "## Repo annex" in agents


def test_example_target_is_synthetic():
    sample = (ROOT / "examples" / "demo-project" / "sample.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "Synthetic example target" in sample

from pathlib import Path

def test_seed_files_present():

    assert '## What this is' in readme

    assert 'MIT' in ('LICENSE' / ROOT).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '__pycache__/' in ('.gitignore' / ROOT).read_text(encoding='utf-8')

def test_readme_status_is_honest():
    readme = ('README.md' / ROOT).read_text(encoding='utf-8')

        assert phrase in status, phrase

    assert 'pull_request' in workflow

    assert '<!-- repo annex below this line -->' in agents
    assert '## Repo annex' in agents

"""Slice 10 tests. Four new seeds and a sixth seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable, and the scoping rules each obligation states get a
content level pin each, at the edges as well as the core.
"""

import ast
import json

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

RAISING_SOURCE = """\
def divide(a, b):
    try:
        return a / b
    except ZeroDivisionError:
        raise ValueError("bad division")
"""

RAISING_TEST = """\
import pytest

from raising import divide


def test_divide():
    assert divide(6, 3) == 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        divide(1, 0)
"""

HEAD_SOURCE = """\
def head(items):
    return items[:2]
"""

HEAD_TEST = """\
from slicing import head


def test_head():
    assert head(["a", "b", "c"]) == ["a", "b"]
    assert head([1]) == [1]
"""

PAGE_SOURCE = """\
def page(items, size=2):
    return items[:size]
"""

PAGE_TEST = """\
from paging import page


def test_page():
    assert page([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 2]
    assert page([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [1, 2, 3]
"""

BASKET_SOURCE = """\
class Basket:
    def __init__(self, items, limit):
        self.items = items
        self.limit = limit

    def summary(self):
        return (len(self.items), self.limit)
"""

BASKET_TEST = """\
from basket import Basket


def test_summary():
    assert Basket(["a", "b"], 5).summary() == (2, 5)
"""

SINGLE_SOURCE = """\
def answer():
    return 42


def show():
    return str(answer())
"""

SINGLE_TEST = """\
from single import answer, show


def test_show():
    assert answer() == 42
    assert show() == "42"
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_five_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/5",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:28]],
    }


def test_seed_twenty_eight_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"raising.py": RAISING_SOURCE, "test_raising.py": RAISING_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-28"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_twenty_eight_swaps_the_raised_type_for_the_first_other_name():
    source = (
        "def divide(a, b):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return a / b\n"
        "    except ZeroDivisionError:\n"
        "        raise ValueError('bad division')\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-28"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "raise ZeroDivisionError('bad division')" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_eight_plants_a_raise_toward_the_head_of_the_order():
    source = (
        "def first():\n"
        "    raise TypeError('one')\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def second():\n"
        "    raise ValueError('two')\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-28"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "raise ValueError('one')" in rendered
    assert "raise TypeError('two')" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_eight_reads_a_handler_name_as_a_replacement():
    source = (
        "def convert(text):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return int(text)\n"
        "    except TypeError:\n"
        "        return 0\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def require(value):\n"
        "    if value is None:\n"
        "        raise ValueError('missing')\n"
        "    return value\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-28"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "raise TypeError('missing')" in rendered

"""Slice 11 tests. Four new seeds and a seventh seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable, and the scoping rules each obligation states get a
content level pin each, at the edges as well as the core.
"""

import ast
import json

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

CONVERT_SOURCE = """\
def convert(text):
    try:
        value = float(text)
        if value > 100:
            raise OverflowError("too big")
        return value
    except Exception:
        return 0.0
"""

CONVERT_TEST = """\
from converting import convert


def test_convert():
    assert convert("5") == 5.0
    assert convert("oops") == 0.0
    assert convert("200") == 0.0
"""

LABEL_SOURCE = """\
def label(name="anon", punct="!"):
    return name + punct
"""

LABEL_TEST = """\
from labelling import label


def test_label():
    assert label() == "anon!"
    assert label("hi") == "hi!"
    assert label("hi", "?") == "hi?"
"""

FETCH_SOURCE = """\
class Handle:
    def __init__(self):
        self.closed = False

    def read(self):
        return "data"

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True


def fetch(handle):
    try:
        return handle.read()
    finally:
        handle.close()
"""

FETCH_TEST = """\
from fetching import Handle, fetch


def test_fetch():
    handle = Handle()
    assert fetch(handle) == "data"
    assert handle.closed is True
"""

GREETING_SOURCE = """\
def shout(fn):
    def wrapper():
        return fn().upper()

    return wrapper


@shout
def greeting():
    return "hi"
"""

GREETING_TEST = """\
from greeting import greeting


def test_greeting():
    assert greeting() == "HI"
"""

SINGLE_SOURCE = """\
def answer():
    return 42


def show():
    return str(answer())
"""

SINGLE_TEST = """\
from single import answer, show


def test_show():
    assert answer() == 42
    assert show() == "42"
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_six_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/6",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:32]],
    }


def test_seed_thirty_two_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"converting.py": CONVERT_SOURCE, "test_converting.py": CONVERT_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-32"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_thirty_two_narrows_the_handler_to_the_first_type_the_try_body_raises():
    tree = ast.parse(CONVERT_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-32"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "except OverflowError:" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_two_narrows_a_base_exception_handler():
    source = (
        "def load(raw):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return parse(raw)\n"
        "    except BaseException:\n"
        "        raise TypeError('bad input')\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-32"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))
    source = (
        "def load(raw):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        raise TypeError('bad input')\n"
        "    except BaseException:\n"
        "        return None\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-32"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "except TypeError:" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_two_narrows_a_tuple_handler_as_a_whole():
    source = (
        "def load(raw):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        raise ValueError('bad input')\n"
        "    except (KeyError, Exception):\n"
        "        return None\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-32"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "except ValueError:" in rendered
    assert "KeyError" not in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_two_gathers_a_raise_from_a_try_nested_in_the_body():
    source = (
        "def load(raw):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        try:\n"
        "            raise KeyError('missing')\n"
        "        except KeyError:\n"
        "            pass\n"
        "        return raw\n"
        "    except Exception:\n"
        "        return None\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-32"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "except KeyError:\n        return None" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_two_leaves_a_raise_inside_a_nested_function_out_of_the_reading():
    source = (
        "def load(raw):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        def build():\n"
        "            raise ValueError('bad input')\n"
        "        return build\n"
        "    except Exception:\n"
        "        return None\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-32"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_thirty_two_leaves_a_handler_that_names_no_broad_base_standing():
    source = (
        "def load(raw):\n"

        "        raise ValueError('bad input')\n"

def test_seed_thirty_two_narrows_only_the_broad_handler_of_a_try():
    source = (
        "def load(raw):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        raise TypeError('bad input')\n"
        "    except ValueError:\n"
        "        return 1\n"
        "    except Exception:\n"
        "        return 2\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-32"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "except ValueError:" in rendered
    assert "except TypeError:" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_two_not_applicable_without_a_broad_handler(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"single.py": SINGLE_SOURCE, "test_single.py": SINGLE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-32"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_thirty_three_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"labelling.py": LABEL_SOURCE, "test_labelling.py": LABEL_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-33"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_thirty_three_swaps_the_first_two_positional_defaults():
    tree = ast.parse("def scale(a=1, b=2):\n    return (a, b)\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-33"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "def scale(a=2, b=1):" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_three_swaps_a_positional_default_with_a_keyword_only_default():
    tree = ast.parse("def scale(a=1, *, b=2):\n    return (a, b)\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-33"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "def scale(a=2, *, b=1):" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_three_keeps_the_third_default_standing():
    tree = ast.parse("def scale(a=1, b=2, c=3):\n    return (a, b, c)\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-33"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "def scale(a=2, b=1, c=3):" in rendered


def test_seed_thirty_three_swaps_two_keyword_only_defaults():
    source = "def scale(*, a=1, b=2):\n    return (a, b)\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-33"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "def scale(*, a=2, b=1):" in rendered
    source = "def scale(a, *, key, b=2, c=3):\n    return (b, c)\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-33"].apply(tree) is True

"""Slice 12 tests. Four new seeds and an eighth seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable, and the scoping rules each obligation states get a
content level pin each, at the edges as well as the core.
"""

import ast
import json

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

PARSE_SOURCE = """\
def parse(text):
    try:
        return int(text)
    except ValueError:
        return -1
    except TypeError:
        return -2
"""

PARSE_TEST = """\
from parsing import parse


def test_parse():
    assert parse("42") == 42
    assert parse("oops") == -1
    assert parse(None) == -2
"""

ITEMS_SOURCE = """\
def first_items():
    yield "a"
    yield "b"
"""

ITEMS_TEST = """\
from items import first_items


def test_first_items():
    assert list(first_items()) == ["a", "b"]
"""

ADMISSION_SOURCE = """\
def admitted(age, member):
    return age >= 18 and member
"""

ADMISSION_TEST = """\
from admission import admitted


def test_admitted():
    assert admitted(20, True) is True
    assert admitted(20, False) is False
    assert admitted(10, True) is False
"""

SHAPES_SOURCE = """\
class Named:
    def label(self):
        return "named"


class Widget(Named):
    pass
"""

SHAPES_TEST = """\
from shapes import Widget


def test_widget():
    assert Widget().label() == "named"
"""

SINGLE_SOURCE = """\
def answer():
    return 42


def show():
    return str(answer())
"""

SINGLE_TEST = """\
from single import answer, show


def test_show():
    assert answer() == 42
    assert show() == "42"
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_seven_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/7",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:36]],
    }


def test_seed_thirty_six_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):

        tmp_path / "project",
        {"parsing.py": PARSE_SOURCE, "test_parsing.py": PARSE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-36"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_thirty_six_drops_the_first_handler_and_keeps_the_rest():
    source = (
        "def fetch(handle):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return handle.read()\n"
        "    except ValueError:\n"
        "        return 'bad'\n"
        "    except OSError:\n"
        "        return 'gone'\n"
        "    else:\n"
        "        return 'ok'\n"
        "    finally:\n"
        "        handle.close()\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-36"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "except ValueError:" not in rendered
    assert "return 'bad'" not in rendered
    assert "except OSError:" in rendered
    assert "return handle.read()" in rendered
    assert "finally:" in rendered
    assert "handle.close()" in rendered

def test_seed_thirty_six_plants_on_a_try_star_statement():

    tree = ast.parse(ITEMS_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-37"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "yield" not in rendered
    reparsed = ast.parse(rendered)
    function = reparsed.body[0]
    values = [
        statement.value.value
        for statement in function.body
        if isinstance(statement, ast.Expr)
        and isinstance(statement.value, ast.Constant)
    ]
    assert values == ["a", "b"]

    assert "yield" not in rendered
    assert "None" in rendered

    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-37"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "yield" not in rendered
    assert "sent = 5" in rendered

    assert "yield" not in rendered
    assert "3" in rendered

    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-37"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))
    source = "def gen(items):\n    yield from items\n    yield 0\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-37"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "yield from items" in rendered
