"""Slice 13 tests. Four new seeds and a ninth seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable, and the scoping rules each obligation states get a
content level pin each, at the edges as well as the core. Each
caught verdict is earned on a compiling planted copy, because the
Round 11 review fixes record that a catch against a tree the
language refuses is no catch at all.
"""

import ast
import json
import shutil

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, plant_seed, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

TAIL_SOURCE = """\
def tail(items):
    rest = items[1:]
    return rest
"""

TAIL_TEST = """\
from slicing import tail


def test_tail():
    assert tail([10, 20, 30]) == [20, 30]
"""

COLLECT_SOURCE = """\
def collect(items):
    found = []
    for item in items:
        if item is None:
            continue
        found.append(item)
    return found
"""

COLLECT_TEST = """\
from collecting import collect


def test_collect():
    assert collect([1, None, 2, None, 3]) == [1, 2, 3]
"""

COUNTER_SOURCE = """\
COUNT = 0


def bump():
    global COUNT
    COUNT += 1


def total():
    return COUNT
"""

COUNTER_TEST = """\
from counter import bump, total


def test_bump_moves_the_counter():
    bump()
    assert total() == 1
"""

ENDPOINTS_SOURCE = """\
def endpoints():
    low, high = 1, 10
    return low, high
"""

ENDPOINTS_TEST = """\
from endpoints import endpoints


def test_endpoints():
    assert endpoints() == (1, 10)
"""

SINGLE_SOURCE = """\
def answer():
    return 42


def show():
    return str(answer())
"""

SINGLE_TEST = """\
from single import answer, show


def test_show():
    assert answer() == 42
    assert show() == "42"
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_eight_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/8",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:40]],
    }


def _assert_caught_on_a_compiling_copy(
    tmp_path, seed_id, files, module_name
):
    target = _write_project(tmp_path / "project", files)
    planted = tmp_path / "planted"
    shutil.copytree(target, planted)
    changed = plant_seed(planted, SEEDS_BY_ID[seed_id])
    assert changed == [module_name]
    compile(
        (planted / module_name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        module_name,
        "exec",
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)[seed_id] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_forty_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    _assert_caught_on_a_compiling_copy(
        tmp_path,
        "seed-40",
        {"slicing.py": TAIL_SOURCE, "test_slicing.py": TAIL_TEST},
        "slicing.py",
    )


def test_seed_forty_shifts_the_start_by_one():
    tree = ast.parse(TAIL_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "items[2:]" in rendered
    assert "items[1:]" not in rendered


def test_seed_forty_leaves_the_stop_and_the_step_standing():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return items[1:9:2]\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    subscript = ast.parse(rendered).body[0].body[0].value
    assert subscript.slice.lower.value == 2
    assert subscript.slice.upper.value == 9
    assert subscript.slice.step.value == 2


def test_seed_forty_plants_a_slice_inside_a_tuple_index():
    source = "def f(grid):\n    return grid[1:2, 0]\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "grid[2:2, 0]" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_leaves_a_negative_start_standing():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return items[-1:]\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_leaves_a_computed_start_standing():
    source = (
        "def f(items, n):\n"
        "    head = items[n:]\n"
        "    rest = items[n + 1:]\n"
        "    return head, rest\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_leaves_a_boolean_start_standing():
    source = "def f(items):\n    return items[True:]\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_plants_the_start_standing_in_an_assignment():
    tree = ast.parse(TAIL_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-03"].apply(tree) is False
    tree = ast.parse(TAIL_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is True
    source = "def answer():\n    return 42\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is False
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-03"].apply(tree) is True


def test_seed_forty_and_seed_twenty_nine_plant_opposite_bounds_of_one_slice():
    source = "def f(items):\n    part = items[1:3]\n    return part\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-40"].apply(tree) is True
    start_rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "items[2:3]" in start_rendered
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-29"].apply(tree) is True
    stop_rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "items[1:4]" in stop_rendered
    assert start_rendered != stop_rendered


def test_seed_forty_not_applicable_without_a_constant_start(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"single.py": SINGLE_SOURCE, "test_single.py": SINGLE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-40"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_forty_one_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    _assert_caught_on_a_compiling_copy(
        tmp_path,
        "seed-41",
        {"collecting.py": COLLECT_SOURCE, "test_collecting.py": COLLECT_TEST},
        "collecting.py",
    )


def test_seed_forty_one_turns_a_continue_into_a_break():
    tree = ast.parse(COLLECT_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-41"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "break" in rendered
    assert "continue" not in rendered
    source = (
        "def drain(queue):\n"
        "    while queue:\n"
        "        item = queue.pop()\n"
        "        if item is None:\n"
        "            continue\n"
        "        print(item)\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-41"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "break" in rendered
    assert "continue" not in rendered


def test_seed_forty_one_plants_the_inner_loop_continue_on_its_own_loop():
    source = (
        "def scan(rows):\n"
        "    total = 0\n"
        "    for row in rows:\n"
        "        for cell in row:\n"
        "            if cell is None:\n"
        "                continue\n"
        "            total += cell\n"
        "    return total\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-41"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "continue" not in rendered
    assert "break" in rendered
    namespace = {}
    exec(rendered, namespace)
    assert namespace["scan"]([[1, None, 2], [3]]) == 4


def test_seed_forty_one_and_seed_twenty_three_hold_disjoint_statements():
    break_source = (
        "def f(items):\n"
        "    for item in items:\n"
        "        if item is None:\n"
        "            break\n"
        "    return items\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(break_source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-41"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(break_source))
    tree = ast.parse(break_source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-23"].apply(tree) is True
    tree = ast.parse(COLLECT_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-23"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(COLLECT_SOURCE))


def test_seed_forty_one_plants_a_continue_in_a_loop_inside_a_nested_function():
    source = (
        "def outer(items):\n"
        "    for item in items:\n"
        "        def helper(values):\n"
        "            kept = []\n"
        "            for value in values:\n"
        "                if value is None:\n"
        "                    continue\n"
        "                kept.append(value)\n"
        "            return kept\n"
        "    return helper\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-41"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "continue" not in rendered
    assert "break" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_one_not_applicable_without_a_continue(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"single.py": SINGLE_SOURCE, "test_single.py": SINGLE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-41"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_forty_two_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    _assert_caught_on_a_compiling_copy(
        tmp_path,
        "seed-42",
        {"counter.py": COUNTER_SOURCE, "test_counter.py": COUNTER_TEST},
        "counter.py",
    )


def test_seed_forty_two_removes_a_global_declaration():
    tree = ast.parse(COUNTER_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-42"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "global" not in rendered
    assert "COUNT += 1" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_two_removes_a_nonlocal_declaration():
    source = (
        "def outer():\n"
        "    total = 0\n"
        "    def inner():\n"
        "        nonlocal total\n"
        "        total += 1\n"
        "    return inner\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-42"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "nonlocal" not in rendered
    assert "total += 1" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_two_removes_every_declaration_standing_in_one_body():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    global FIRST\n"
        "    global SECOND\n"
        "    return 1\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-42"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "global" not in rendered
    assert "return 1" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_two_plants_a_declaration_standing_in_a_nested_list():
    source = (
        "def f(flag):\n"
        "    if flag:\n"
        "        global NESTED\n"
        "        NESTED = 1\n"
        "    return 0\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-42"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "global" not in rendered
    assert "NESTED = 1" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_two_leaves_a_declaration_standing_alone_in_its_list():
    source = "def f():\n    global ONLY\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-42"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))
    source = (
        "def outer():\n"
        "    total = 0\n"
        "    def inner(flag):\n"
        "        if flag:\n"
        "            nonlocal total\n"
        "        return total\n"
        "    return inner\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-42"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_two_leaves_a_list_holding_only_declarations_standing():
    source = "def f():\n    global FIRST\n    global SECOND\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-42"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_two_not_applicable_without_a_declaration(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"single.py": SINGLE_SOURCE, "test_single.py": SINGLE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-42"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_forty_three_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):

        tmp_path,
        "seed-43",
        {"endpoints.py": ENDPOINTS_SOURCE, "test_endpoints.py": ENDPOINTS_TEST},

def test_seed_forty_three_swaps_the_first_two_elements_and_keeps_the_rest():
    source = "def f():\n    values = (1, 2, 3)\n    return values\n"

    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "(2, 1, 3)" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_three_plants_an_annotated_assignment():
    source = "pair: tuple = (1, 2)\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "(2, 1)" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_three_trades_a_starred_element_like_any_other():
    source = "def f(first, rest):\n    head, tail = (first, *rest)\n    return head\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "(*rest, first)" in rendered


def test_seed_forty_three_plants_a_chained_assignment_once():
    source = "a = b = (1, 2)\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert rendered.count("(2, 1)") == 1


def test_seed_forty_three_identical_elements_exchange_into_themselves():
    source = "same = (7, 7)\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is True
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_three_and_the_call_and_definition_exchanges_hold_disjoint_ground():
    tree = ast.parse(ENDPOINTS_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-20"].apply(tree) is False
    tree = ast.parse(ENDPOINTS_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-27"].apply(tree) is False
    tree = ast.parse(ENDPOINTS_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-33"].apply(tree) is False
    tree = ast.parse(ENDPOINTS_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is True
    source = (
        "def f(a=1, b=2):\n"
        "    return combine(a, b, left=a, right=b)\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_three_leaves_a_single_element_tuple_standing():
    source = "pair = (1,)\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))
    source = "pair = 1\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-43"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_forty_three_not_applicable_without_a_tuple_assignment(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"single.py": SINGLE_SOURCE, "test_single.py": SINGLE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-43"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_version_eight_pack_still_loads_the_forty(tmp_path):
    entries = load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, _version_eight_data()))
    assert [entry["id"] for entry in entries] == [
        seed.id for seed in SEEDS[:40]
    ]


def test_a_version_nine_pack_with_an_invented_id_is_refused(tmp_path):
    data = seed_pack_data()
    data["seeds"][43]["id"] = "seed-99"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ids do not match"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_version_eight_pack_carrying_a_grown_registry_id_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    data = _version_eight_data()
    data["seeds"][39] = _entry(SEEDS[40])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ids do not match"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_pack_whose_count_disagrees_with_version_nine_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    forty_under_v9 = _version_eight_data()
    forty_under_v9["format"] = "canaryfield-seeds/9"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="carries 44"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, forty_under_v9))
    current_under_v8 = seed_pack_data()
    current_under_v8["format"] = "canaryfield-seeds/8"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="carries 40"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, current_under_v8))

cases.source:
"""Slice 14 tests. Four new seeds and a tenth seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable, and the scoping rules each obligation states get a
content level pin each, at the edges as well as the core. Each
caught verdict is earned on a compiling planted copy, because the
Round 11 review fixes record that a catch against a tree the
language refuses is no catch at all. The two seeds whose removal
can strand a nonlocal declaration are also pinned at the engine
write path, where a planting the language refuses is never written.
"""

import ast
import json
import shutil

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, plant_seed, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

SEARCH_SOURCE = """\
def first_big(items):
    for item in items:
        if item > 10:
            break
    else:
        return "none"
    return item
"""

SEARCH_TEST = """\
from searching import first_big


def test_first_big():
    assert first_big([1, 2]) == "none"
    assert first_big([20, 30]) == 20
"""

GREET_SOURCE = """\
def greet(name, punct="!"):
    return name + punct


def banner():
    return greet("hi", punct="?")
"""

GREET_TEST = """\
from greeting import banner


def test_banner():
    assert banner() == "hi?"
"""

EVENS_SOURCE = """\
def evens():
    return list(range(0, 10, 2))
"""

EVENS_TEST = """\
from evens import evens


def test_evens():
    assert evens() == [0, 2, 4, 6, 8]
"""

BLOCK_SOURCE = """\
def blocked(flag):
    return not flag
"""

BLOCK_TEST = """\
from blocking import blocked


def test_blocked():
    assert blocked(False) is True
    assert blocked(True) is False
"""

SINGLE_SOURCE = """\
def answer():
    return 42


def show():
    return str(answer())
"""

SINGLE_TEST = """\
from single import answer, show


def test_show():
    assert answer() == 42
    assert show() == "42"
"""

LOOP_ELSE_BINDING_SOURCE = """\
def outer():
    def inner():
        nonlocal x
        return x
    for i in range(3):
        pass
    else:
        x = 1
    return inner
"""

KEYWORD_BINDING_SOURCE = """\
def outer():
    def inner():
        nonlocal x
        return x
    return combine(value=(x := 3)), inner
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_nine_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/9",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:44]],
    }


def _assert_caught_on_a_compiling_copy(
    tmp_path, seed_id, files, module_name
):
    target = _write_project(tmp_path / "project", files)
    planted = tmp_path / "planted"
    shutil.copytree(target, planted)
    changed = plant_seed(planted, SEEDS_BY_ID[seed_id])
    assert changed == [module_name]
    compile(
        (planted / module_name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        module_name,
        "exec",
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)[seed_id] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_forty_four_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    _assert_caught_on_a_compiling_copy(
        tmp_path,
        "seed-44",
        {"searching.py": SEARCH_SOURCE, "test_searching.py": SEARCH_TEST},
        "searching.py",
    )


def test_seed_forty_four_drops_the_else_clause_of_a_for_loop():
    tree = ast.parse(SEARCH_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-44"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "else" not in rendered
    assert "break" in rendered
    namespace = {}
    exec(rendered, namespace)
    assert namespace["first_big"]([1, 2]) == 2
    assert namespace["first_big"]([20, 30]) == 20


def test_seed_forty_four_drops_the_else_clause_of_a_while_loop():
    source = (
        "def drain(queue):\n"
        "    found = []\n"
        "    while queue:\n"
        "        item = queue.pop()\n"
        "        if item is None:\n"
        "            break\n"
        "        found.append(item)\n"
        "    else:\n"
        "        return found, 'drained'\n"
        "    return found, 'stopped'\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-44"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    compile(rendered, "planted", "exec")
    assert "else" not in rendered
    namespace = {}
    exec(rendered, namespace)
    assert namespace["drain"]([1, 2]) == ([2, 1], "stopped")


def test_seed_forty_four_drops_the_else_clause_of_an_async_for_loop():
    source = (
        "async def collect(stream):\n"
        "    found = []\n"

"""Slice 2 tests. Git branch planting, the two gate example, the seed pack.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Git fixtures
are throwaway repositories built inside the test temp dirs.
"""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from canaryfield.cli import main as cli_main
from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, WAVED, hash_tree, run_field
from canaryfield.report import to_json, to_text
from canaryfield.seedpack import SEED_PACK_FORMAT, load_seed_pack, write_seed_pack
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS

from fixture_project import GATE, write_main_project, write_tiny_project

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
NOOP_GATE = ("noop", "true")
COMPILE_GATE = ("compile", "python3 -m compileall -q .")


def _git(cwd, *arguments):
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(cwd)] + list(arguments),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
    return completed.stdout.strip()


def _write_git_project(root):
    _git(root, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    _git(root, "add", "-A")
    _git(
        root,
        "-c",
        "user.name=Fixture",
        "-c",
        "user.email=fixture@example.invalid",
        "commit",
        "-q",
        "-m",
        "Initial fixture commit",
    )
    return root


def _git_state(root):
    return {
        "head": _git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
        "branches": _git(root, "branch", "--format=%(refname:short)"),
        "status": _git(root, "status", "--porcelain"),
        "hashes": hash_tree(root),
    }


def _branches(clone):
    return set(_git(clone, "branch", "--format=%(refname:short)").splitlines())


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def git_run(tmp_path_factory):
    target = _write_git_project(
        write_main_project(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("git-target") / "project")
    )
    before = _git_state(target)
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60, plant_mode="git-branches")
    after = _git_state(target)
    return target, before, after, result


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def git_clone_kept(tmp_path_factory):
    base = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("git-kept")
    target = _write_git_project(write_main_project(base / "project"))
    work_root = base / "work"
    result = run_field(
        target,
        [NOOP_GATE],
        timeout=30,
        work_root=work_root,
        keep_scratch=True,
        plant_mode="git-branches",
    )
    return target, work_root / "clone", result


def test_git_mode_scores_caught_and_waved(git_run):
    _target, _before, _after, result = git_run
    assert result["plant_mode"] == "git-branches"
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    cells = {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}
    assert cells["seed-01"] == CAUGHT
    assert cells["seed-00"] == CAUGHT
    assert cells["seed-07"] == WAVED
    assert cells["seed-09"] == WAVED
    summary = result["summary"]["tests"]
    assert summary[CAUGHT] == 14
    assert summary[WAVED] == 3
    for row in result["rows"]:
        if row["planted_files"]:
            assert row["branch"] == f"canaryfield/{row['seed']}"
        else:
            assert row["branch"] is None


def test_git_mode_target_git_state_untouched(git_run):

    assert result["target_unchanged"] is True

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Git fixtures
are throwaway repositories built inside the test temp dirs.

import subprocess

import pytest

)

    ALPHA_SOURCE,
    BETA_SOURCE,
    GATE,
    write_tiny_project,
    write_two_module_project,
)

NOOP_GATE = ("noop", "true")


def _git(cwd, *arguments):
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", str(cwd)] + list(arguments),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
    return completed.stdout.strip()


def _write_git_project(root):
    _git(root, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    _git(root, "add", "-A")
    _git(
        root,
        "-c",
        "user.name=Fixture",
        "-c",
        "user.email=fixture@example.invalid",
        "commit",
        "-q",
        "-m",
        "Initial fixture commit",
    )
    return root


def _git_state(root):
    return {
        "head": _git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
        "branches": _git(root, "branch", "--format=%(refname:short)"),
        "status": _git(root, "status", "--porcelain"),
        "hashes": hash_tree(root),
    }


def _rows(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row for row in result["rows"]}

def two_module_run(tmp_path_factory):
    target = write_two_module_project(
        tmp_path_factory.mktemp("two-module") / "project"
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    return target, result


def test_plant_seed_covers_every_applicable_file(tmp_path):
    scratch = write_two_module_project(tmp_path / "scratch")
    planted = plant_seed(scratch, SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-01"])
    assert planted == ["alpha.py", "beta.py"]
    alpha = (scratch / "alpha.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    beta = (scratch / "beta.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert alpha != ALPHA_SOURCE
    assert beta != BETA_SOURCE
    assert "return 10" not in alpha
    assert "return 20" not in beta

    rows = _rows(result)

    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_file"] == "alpha.py"

    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_file"] == "tiny.py"
    assert rows["seed-01"]["gates"]["tests"] == CAUGHT

    assert rows["seed-00"]["gates"]["tests"] == NOT_APPLICABLE

    )

        clone, "show", "--name-only", "--format=", "canaryfield/seed-01"
    )
    assert sorted(committed.splitlines()) == ["alpha.py", "beta.py"]

    assert _git(target, "branch", "--format=%(refname:short)") == "main"


def test_git_mode_multi_file_fixture_scores_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_git_project(write_two_module_project(tmp_path / "project"))
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60, plant_mode="git-branches")
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["alpha.py", "beta.py"]
    assert rows["seed-01"]["gates"]["tests"] == CAUGHT

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, WAVED, hash_tree, plant_seed, run_field
from canaryfield.report import to_json, to_text
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID
from fixture_project import ALPHA_SOURCE, BETA_SOURCE, GATE, write_tiny_project, write_two_module_project
NOOP_GATE = ('noop', 'true')

def _git(cwd, *arguments):
    completed = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(cwd)] + list(arguments), capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
    return completed.stdout.strip()

def _write_git_project(root):
    _git(root, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main')
    _git(root, 'add', '-A')
    _git(root, '-c', 'user.name=Fixture', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'Initial fixture commit')
    return root

def _git_state(root):
    return {'head': _git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'branches': _git(root, 'branch', '--format=%(refname:short)'), 'status': _git(root, 'status', '--porcelain'), 'hashes': hash_tree(root)}

def _rows(result):
    return {row['seed']: row for row in result['rows']}

@pytest.fixture(scope='module')
def two_module_run(tmp_path_factory):
    target = write_two_module_project('project' / tmp_path_factory.mktemp('two-module'))
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    return (target, result)

def test_plant_seed_covers_every_applicable_file(tmp_path):
    scratch = write_two_module_project('scratch' / tmp_path)
    planted = plant_seed(scratch, SEEDS_BY_ID['seed-01'])
    assert planted == ['alpha.py', 'beta.py']
    alpha = ('alpha.py' / scratch).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    beta = ('beta.py' / scratch).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert alpha != ALPHA_SOURCE
    assert beta != BETA_SOURCE
    assert 'return 10' not in alpha
    assert 'return 20' not in beta
    untouched = write_two_module_project('untouched' / tmp_path)
    assert plant_seed(untouched, SEEDS_BY_ID['seed-00']) == []
    assert ('alpha.py' / untouched).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == ALPHA_SOURCE

def test_multi_file_fixture_names_every_planted_file(two_module_run):
    _target, result = two_module_run
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows['seed-01']['planted_files'] == ['alpha.py', 'beta.py']
    assert rows['seed-01']['planted_file'] == 'alpha.py'
    assert rows['seed-06']['planted_files'] == ['alpha.py', 'beta.py']
    assert rows['seed-00']['planted_files'] == []
    assert rows['seed-00']['planted_file'] is None
    assert rows['seed-00']['gates']['tests'] == NOT_APPLICABLE

def test_report_lists_every_planted_file_in_text_and_json(two_module_run):
    _target, result = two_module_run
    text = to_text(result)
    assert 'planted in alpha.py, beta.py' in text
    data = json.loads(to_json(result))
    rows = {row['seed']: row for row in data['rows']}
    assert rows['seed-01']['planted_files'] == ['alpha.py', 'beta.py']
    assert rows['seed-00']['planted_files'] == []

def test_multi_file_fixture_scores_the_fully_planted_state(two_module_run):
    _target, result = two_module_run
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows['seed-01']['gates']['tests'] == CAUGHT
    assert rows['seed-03']['gates']['tests'] == CAUGHT
    assert rows['seed-06']['gates']['tests'] == CAUGHT
    summary = result['summary']['tests']
    assert summary[CAUGHT] == 3
    assert summary[WAVED] == 0
    assert summary[NOT_APPLICABLE] == 45
    assert result['target_unchanged'] is True

def test_single_file_fixture_matches_slice_two_verdicts(tmp_path):
    target = write_tiny_project('tiny' / tmp_path)
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows['seed-01']['planted_files'] == ['tiny.py']
    assert rows['seed-01']['planted_file'] == 'tiny.py'
    assert rows['seed-01']['gates']['tests'] == CAUGHT
    assert rows['seed-03']['planted_files'] == ['tiny.py']
    assert rows['seed-03']['gates']['tests'] == CAUGHT
    assert rows['seed-00']['planted_files'] == []
    assert rows['seed-00']['gates']['tests'] == NOT_APPLICABLE

def test_git_mode_branch_commit_carries_every_planted_file(tmp_path):
    target = _write_git_project(write_two_module_project('project' / tmp_path))
    before = _git_state(target)
    work_root = 'work' / tmp_path
    result = run_field(target, [NOOP_GATE], timeout=30, work_root=work_root, keep_scratch=True, plant_mode='git-branches')
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows['seed-01']['planted_files'] == ['alpha.py', 'beta.py']
    assert rows['seed-01']['branch'] == 'canaryfield/seed-01'
    clone = 'clone' / work_root
    committed = _git(clone, 'show', '--name-only', '--format=', 'canaryfield/seed-01')
    assert sorted(committed.splitlines()) == ['alpha.py', 'beta.py']
    planted_alpha = _git(clone, 'show', 'canaryfield/seed-01:alpha.py')
    planted_beta = _git(clone, 'show', 'canaryfield/seed-01:beta.py')
    assert 'return 10' not in planted_alpha
    assert 'return 20' not in planted_beta
    base_alpha = _git(clone, 'show', 'main:alpha.py')
    assert 'return 10' in base_alpha
    assert result['target_unchanged'] is True
    assert _git_state(target) == before
    assert _git(target, 'branch', '--format=%(refname:short)') == 'main'

def test_git_mode_multi_file_fixture_scores_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_git_project(write_two_module_project('project' / tmp_path))
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60, plant_mode='git-branches')
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows['seed-01']['planted_files'] == ['alpha.py', 'beta.py']

"""Slice 4 tests. Plant at every matching shape inside one file.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Git fixtures
are throwaway repositories built inside the test temp dirs.
"""

import ast
import subprocess
import sys

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, plant_seed, run_field
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE, write_tiny_project
from test_slice3 import NOOP_GATE, _git, _write_git_project

TRIPLE_SOURCE = """\
def first():
    return 1


def second():
    return 2


def third():
    return 3
"""

TRIPLE_TEST_SOURCE = """\
from multi import first, second, third


def test_first():
    assert first() == 1


def test_second():
    assert second() == 2


def test_third():
    assert third() == 3
"""

SECOND_SOURCE = """\
def first():
    return 1


def second():
    return 2
"""

SECOND_TEST_SOURCE = """\
from pair import second


def test_second():
    assert second() == 2
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _rows(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row for row in result["rows"]}


def _gate_exit(directory):
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q"],
        cwd=directory,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return completed.returncode


def _return_values(tree):
    return [
        node.value
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Return)
    ]


def test_one_apply_call_plants_every_match():
    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-01"]
    tree = ast.parse(TRIPLE_SOURCE)
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    assert _return_values(tree) == [None, None, None]

    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-05"]
    tree = ast.parse("A = True\nB = False\n")
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "A = False" in rendered
    assert "B = True" in rendered

    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-06"]
    tree = ast.parse("def f(x, y):\n    return x * 2 + y\n")
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    assert "x + 2 - y" in ast.unparse(tree)

    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-10"]
    tree = ast.parse("def f():\n    return list(range(3)) + list(range(5))\n")
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    calls = [
        node
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
        and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
        and node.func.id == "range"
    ]
    assert len(calls) == 2
    for call in calls:
        assert isinstance(call.args[-1], ast.BinOp)


def test_three_occurrences_in_one_file_are_all_planted(tmp_path):
    files = {"multi.py": TRIPLE_SOURCE, "test_multi.py": TRIPLE_TEST_SOURCE}
    scratch = _write_project(tmp_path / "scratch", files)
    planted = plant_seed(scratch, SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-01"])
    assert planted == ["multi.py"]
    tree = ast.parse(
        (scratch / "multi.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    values = _return_values(tree)
    assert len(values) == 3
    assert values == [None, None, None]

    target = _write_project(tmp_path / "project", files)
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["multi.py"]
    assert rows["seed-01"]["gates"]["tests"] == CAUGHT
    assert result["target_unchanged"] is True


def test_second_occurrence_only_fixture_flips_with_the_widening(tmp_path):
    files = {"pair.py": SECOND_SOURCE, "test_pair.py": SECOND_TEST_SOURCE}
    old_style = _write_project(tmp_path / "old-style", files)
    pair = old_style / "pair.py"
    text = pair.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "    return 1\n" in text and "    return 2\n" in text
    pair.write_text(text.replace("    return 1\n", "    return\n", 1), encoding="utf-8")
    assert "    return 2\n" in pair.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert _gate_exit(old_style) == 0

    target = _write_project(tmp_path / "project", files)
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["pair.py"]
    assert rows["seed-01"]["gates"]["tests"] == CAUGHT


def test_a_partly_planted_file_plants_the_rest(tmp_path):
    scratch = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "scratch",
        {"versions.py": 'VERSION = "9.9.9"\n__version__ = "1.2.3"\n'},
    )
    planted = plant_seed(scratch, SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-00"])
    assert planted == ["versions.py"]
    tree = ast.parse(
        (scratch / "versions.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    values = [
        node.value.value
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
    ]
    assert values == ["9.9.9", "9.9.9"]


def test_a_fully_planted_file_plants_nothing(tmp_path):
    scratch = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "scratch",
        {"versions.py": 'VERSION = "9.9.9"\n__version__ = "9.9.9"\n'},
    )
    assert plant_seed(scratch, SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-00"]) == []


def test_a_planted_shape_is_not_planted_twice():
    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-06"]
    tree = ast.parse("def scale(x):\n    return x * 2\n")
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "x + 2" in rendered
    assert "x - 2" not in rendered

    seed = SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-05"]
    tree = ast.parse("A = True\n")
    assert seed.apply(tree) is True
    assert "A = False" in ast.unparse(tree)


def test_negated_conditions_wrap_exactly_once():
    source = (
        "def pick(a, b):\n"
        "    if a:\n"
        "        if b:\n"
        "            return 1\n"
        "    return 0\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-08"].apply(tree) is True
    conditions = [
        node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.If)
    ]
    assert len(conditions) == 2
    for condition in conditions:
        assert isinstance(condition.test, ast.UnaryOp)
        assert isinstance(condition.test.op, ast.Not)
        assert not isinstance(condition.test.operand, ast.UnaryOp)


def test_range_bounds_shift_exactly_once():
    source = "def count():\n    return list(range(3)) + list(range(5))\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-10"].apply(tree) is True
    calls = [
        node
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
        and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
        and node.func.id == "range"
    ]
    assert len(calls) == 2
    bounds = []
    for call in calls:
        bound = call.args[-1]
        assert isinstance(bound, ast.BinOp)
        assert isinstance(bound.left, ast.Constant)
        bounds.append(bound.left.value)
    assert bounds == [3, 5]


def test_a_match_inside_a_swallowed_handler_stays_detached():
    source = (
        "def f():\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        risky()\n"
        "    except ValueError:\n"
        "        try:\n"
        "            fallback()\n"
        "        except KeyError:\n"
        "            raise\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-04"].apply(tree) is True
    handlers = [
        node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.ExceptHandler)
    ]
    assert len(handlers) == 1
    assert len(handlers[0].body) == 1
    assert isinstance(handlers[0].body[0], ast.Pass)
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "fallback" not in rendered
    assert "raise" not in rendered


def test_single_occurrence_fixture_keeps_its_slice_three_verdicts(tmp_path):
    target = write_tiny_project(tmp_path / "tiny")
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["tiny.py"]
    assert rows["seed-01"]["gates"]["tests"] == CAUGHT
    assert rows["seed-03"]["planted_files"] == ["tiny.py"]
    assert rows["seed-03"]["gates"]["tests"] == CAUGHT
    assert rows["seed-00"]["planted_files"] == []
    assert rows["seed-00"]["gates"]["tests"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_git_mode_branch_commit_carries_the_fully_planted_file(tmp_path):
    target = _write_git_project(
        _write_project(
            tmp_path / "project",
            {"multi.py": TRIPLE_SOURCE, "test_multi.py": TRIPLE_TEST_SOURCE},
        )
    )
    work_root = tmp_path / "work"
    result = run_field(
        target,
        [NOOP_GATE],
        timeout=30,
        work_root=work_root,
        keep_scratch=True,
        plant_mode="git-branches",
    )
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert rows["seed-01"]["planted_files"] == ["multi.py"]
    assert rows["seed-01"]["branch"] == "canaryfield/seed-01"
    committed = _git(
        work_root / "clone", "show", "canaryfield/seed-01:multi.py"
    )
    values = _return_values(ast.parse(committed))
    assert len(values) == 3
    assert values == [None, None, None]
    assert result["target_unchanged"] is True

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

SUB_SOURCE = """\
def difference(a, b):
    return a - b


def ratio(a, b):
    return a / b
"""

SUB_TEST = """\
from calc import difference, ratio


def test_difference():
    assert difference(10, 4) == 6


def test_ratio():
    assert ratio(12, 3) == 4
"""

COMMUTATIVE_SOURCE = """\
def combine(a, b):
    return a + b * 2
"""

COMMUTATIVE_TEST = """\
from mix import combine


def test_combine():
    assert combine(1, 2) == 5
"""

ELSE_SOURCE = """\
def label(flag):
    if flag:
        return "on"
    else:
        return "off"
"""

ELSE_TEST = """\
from label import label


def test_label():
    assert label(True) == "on"
    assert label(False) == "off"
"""

NO_ELSE_SOURCE = """\
def label(flag):
    if flag:
        return "on"
    return "off"
"""

BOOL_SOURCE = """\
def admitted(age, member):
    return age >= 18 and member
"""

BOOL_TEST = """\
from gate import admitted


def test_admitted():
    assert admitted(20, True) is True
    assert admitted(20, False) is False
    assert admitted(10, True) is False
"""

SINGLE_CONDITION_SOURCE = """\
def admitted(age):
    return age >= 18
"""

SINGLE_CONDITION_TEST = """\
from gate import admitted


def test_admitted():
    assert admitted(20) is True
    assert admitted(10) is False
"""

AWAIT_SOURCE = """\
import asyncio


async def fetch():
    return 42


async def get():
    return await fetch()


def value():
    return asyncio.run(get())
"""

AWAIT_TEST = """\
from fetch import value


def test_value():
    assert value() == 42
"""

SYNC_SOURCE = """\
def value():
    return 42
"""

SYNC_TEST = """\
from syncmod import value


def test_value():
    assert value() == 42
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def test_seed_twelve_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"calc.py": SUB_SOURCE, "test_calc.py": SUB_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-12"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_twelve_plants_at_two_occurrences_in_one_file():
    tree = ast.parse(SUB_SOURCE)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-12"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "return b - a" in rendered
    assert "return b / a" in rendered


def test_seed_twelve_plants_a_nested_operation_once_at_each_level():
    tree = ast.parse("def f(a, b, c):\n    return a - b - c\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-12"].apply(tree) is True
    assert "c - (b - a)" in ast.unparse(tree)


def test_seed_twelve_not_applicable_without_a_noncommutative_operator(
    tmp_path,
):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"mix.py": COMMUTATIVE_SOURCE, "test_mix.py": COMMUTATIVE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert _cells(result)["seed-12"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_thirteen_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"label.py": ELSE_SOURCE, "test_label.py": ELSE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-13"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_thirteen_drops_an_elif_chain_with_the_else():
    source = (
        "def label(n):\n"
        "    if n == 1:\n"
        "        return 'one'\n"
        "    elif n == 2:\n"
        "        return 'two'\n"
        "    else:\n"
        "        return 'other'\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-13"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "return 'one'" in rendered
    assert "return 'two'" not in rendered
    assert "return 'other'" not in rendered


def test_seed_thirteen_not_applicable_without_an_else_branch(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"label.py": NO_ELSE_SOURCE, "test_label.py": ELSE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert _cells(result)["seed-13"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_fourteen_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"gate.py": BOOL_SOURCE, "test_gate.py": BOOL_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-14"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_fourteen_not_applicable_without_a_compound_condition(
    tmp_path,
):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {
            "gate.py": SINGLE_CONDITION_SOURCE,
            "test_gate.py": SINGLE_CONDITION_TEST,
        },
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert _cells(result)["seed-14"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_fifteen_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"fetch.py": AWAIT_SOURCE, "test_fetch.py": AWAIT_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-15"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_fifteen_plants_an_await_nested_inside_an_await():
    source = (
        "async def get():\n"
        "    return await fetch(await inner())\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-15"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "return fetch(inner())" in rendered
    assert "await" not in rendered


def test_seed_fifteen_not_applicable_without_an_await(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"syncmod.py": SYNC_SOURCE, "test_syncmod.py": SYNC_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert _cells(result)["seed-15"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _version_one_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/1",
        "seeds": [
            {
                "id": seed.id,
                "name": seed.name,
                "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
                "description": seed.description,
            }
            for seed in SEEDS[:12]
        ],
    }


def test_version_one_pack_still_loads_the_original_twelve(tmp_path):
    entries = load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, _version_one_data()))
    assert [entry["id"] for entry in entries] == [
        f"seed-{index:02d}" for index in range(12)
    ]
    assert [entry["id"] for entry in entries] == [
        seed.id for seed in SEEDS[:12]
    ]


def test_a_pack_whose_count_disagrees_with_its_version_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    current_under_v1 = seed_pack_data()
    current_under_v1["format"] = "canaryfield-seeds/1"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="carries 12"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, current_under_v1))
    twelve_under_v2 = _version_one_data()
    twelve_under_v2["format"] = "canaryfield-seeds/2"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="carries 16"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, twelve_under_v2))

"""Tests for the slice 6 obligations in CONTRACT.md.

Slice 6 pins each seed pack version to the registry it names. The
loader refuses a pack whose ids are not exactly the id set of its
declared format version and a pack whose entries disagree with the
registry on a name or a defect class, while the description of an
entry stays unverified prose.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this test file.
"""

import json

import pytest

from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_one_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/1",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:12]],
    }


def _version_two_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/2",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:16]],
    }


def test_a_version_one_pack_carrying_a_grown_registry_id_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    data = _version_one_data()
    data["seeds"][11] = _entry(SEEDS[12])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ids do not match"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_version_one_pack_with_an_invented_id_is_refused(tmp_path):
    data = _version_one_data()
    data["seeds"][0]["id"] = "seed-99"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ids do not match"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_version_two_pack_with_an_invented_id_is_refused(tmp_path):
    data = _version_two_data()
    data["seeds"][15]["id"] = "seed-99"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ids do not match"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_pack_entry_order_does_not_matter_for_acceptance(tmp_path):
    data = seed_pack_data()
    data["seeds"] = list(reversed(data["seeds"]))
    entries = load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))
    assert len(entries) == 48
    assert {entry["id"] for entry in entries} == {
        seed.id for seed in SEEDS
    }


def test_a_pack_entry_whose_defect_class_disagrees_with_the_registry_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    data = seed_pack_data()
    data["seeds"][3]["defect_class"] = "wrong predicate"
    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="seed pack entry seed-03 disagrees with the registry"
        " on defect_class",
    ):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_pack_entry_whose_name_disagrees_with_the_registry_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    data = _version_one_data()
    data["seeds"][0]["name"] = "a renamed seed"
    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="seed pack entry seed-00 disagrees with the registry"
        " on name",
    ):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_pack_entry_description_is_prose_and_is_not_verified(tmp_path):
    data = seed_pack_data()
    data["seeds"][5]["description"] = (
        "A reworded description of the same planted defect"
    )
    entries = load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))
    assert len(entries) == 48
    assert entries[5]["description"] == (
        "A reworded description of the same planted defect"
    )

"""Slice 7 tests. Four new seeds and a third seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable.
"""

import ast
import json

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

PARSE_SOURCE = """\
def parse(text):
    try:
        return int(text)
    except ValueError:
        return -1
"""

PARSE_TEST = """\
import pytest

from parsing import parse


def test_parse():
    assert parse("5") == 5
    assert parse("x") == -1
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        parse(None)
"""

BROAD_SOURCE = """\
def value():
    try:
        return int("3")
    except Exception:
        return -1


def other():
    try:
        return int("4")
    except:
        return -1
"""

BROAD_TEST = """\
from broad import other, value


def test_value():
    assert value() == 3


def test_other():
    assert other() == 4
"""

PRICES_SOURCE = """\
PRICES = {"apple": 3, "pear": 5}


def price(item):
    return PRICES[item]
"""

PRICES_TEST = """\
from prices import price


def test_price():
    assert price("apple") == 3
    assert price("pear") == 5
"""

LIST_SOURCE = """\
def toppings():
    return ["soup", "salad"]


def first(items):
    return items[0]
"""

LIST_TEST = """\
from listing import first, toppings


def test_toppings():
    assert toppings() == ["soup", "salad"]


def test_first():
    assert first([9, 8]) == 9
"""

LOOP_SOURCE = """\
def count_down(n):
    total = 0
    while n > 0:
        total += n
        n -= 1
    return total
"""

LOOP_TEST = """\
from counting import count_down


def test_count_down():
    assert count_down(3) == 6
    assert count_down(0) == 0
"""

GUARD_SOURCE = """\
def first_or_none(items):
    if not items:
        return None
    return items[0]
"""

GUARD_TEST = """\
from guard import first_or_none


def test_first_or_none():
    assert first_or_none([]) is None
    assert first_or_none([7]) == 7
"""

PLAIN_IF_SOURCE = """\
def describe(flag):
    if flag:
        return "on"
    return "off"
"""

PLAIN_IF_TEST = """\
from plain import describe


def test_describe():
    assert describe(True) == "on"
    assert describe(False) == "off"
"""

TOTAL_SOURCE = """\
def total(values):
    result = 0
    for value in values:
        result += value
    return result
"""

TOTAL_TEST = """\
from totalling import total


def test_total():
    assert total([1, 2, 3]) == 6
    assert total([]) == 0
"""

LONE_LOOP_SOURCE = """\
for item in [1, 2]:
    print(item)
"""

LONE_LOOP_TEST = """\
import loopy


def test_module_ran():
    assert loopy is not None
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def test_seed_sixteen_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"parsing.py": PARSE_SOURCE, "test_parsing.py": PARSE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-16"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_sixteen_widens_the_type_and_keeps_the_body():
    source = (
        "def safe_div(a, b):\n"
        "    try:\n"
        "        return a / b\n"
        "    except ZeroDivisionError:\n"
        "        raise ValueError('bad division')\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-16"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "except Exception" in rendered
    assert "raise ValueError('bad division')" in rendered
    assert "ZeroDivisionError" not in rendered


def test_seed_sixteen_not_applicable_without_a_typed_handler(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"broad.py": BROAD_SOURCE, "test_broad.py": BROAD_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert _cells(result)["seed-16"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_seventeen_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"prices.py": PRICES_SOURCE, "test_prices.py": PRICES_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-17"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_seventeen_swaps_every_keyed_entry():
    tree = ast.parse('DATA = {"a": 1, "b": {"c": 2}}\n')

"""Slice 8 tests. Four new seeds and a fourth seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable, and the scoping rules each obligation states get a
content level pin each.
"""

import ast
import json

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

COMBINE_SOURCE = """\
def combine(left, right):
    return left * 10 + right


def score():
    return combine(3, 4)
"""

COMBINE_TEST = """\
from combining import score


def test_score():
    assert score() == 34
"""

SINGLE_SOURCE = """\
def answer():
    return 42


def show():
    return str(answer())
"""

SINGLE_TEST = """\
from single import answer, show


def test_show():
    assert answer() == 42
    assert show() == "42"
"""

LABEL_SOURCE = """\
def status():
    return "ready"
"""

LABEL_TEST = """\
from labelling import status


def test_status():
    assert status() == "ready"
"""

DOCS_SOURCE = '''\
"""Module notes written for this fixture."""


def answer():
    return 42
'''

DOCS_TEST = """\
from documented import answer


def test_answer():
    assert answer() == 42
"""

OFFSET_SOURCE = """\
def adjust(value):
    return -value
"""

OFFSET_TEST = """\
from offsetting import adjust


def test_adjust():
    assert adjust(5) == -5
    assert adjust(-3) == 3
"""

IDENTITY_SOURCE = """\
def identity(value):
    return value
"""

IDENTITY_TEST = """\
from identity import identity


def test_identity():
    assert identity(7) == 7
"""

SEARCH_SOURCE = """\
def find_first(values, wanted):
    found = -1
    for index, value in enumerate(values):
        if value == wanted:
            found = index
            break
    return found
"""

SEARCH_TEST = """\
from searching import find_first


def test_find_first():
    assert find_first([5, 7, 5], 5) == 0
    assert find_first([1, 2], 9) == -1
"""

SUM_SOURCE = """\
def total(values):
    result = 0
    for value in values:
        result += value
    return result
"""

SUM_TEST = """\
from summing import total


def test_total():
    assert total([1, 2, 3]) == 6
    assert total([]) == 0
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def test_seed_twenty_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"combining.py": COMBINE_SOURCE, "test_combining.py": COMBINE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-20"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_twenty_swaps_the_first_two_arguments():
    tree = ast.parse("result = combine(left, right)\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-20"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "combine(right, left)" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_leaves_keyword_arguments_standing():
    tree = ast.parse("result = combine(left, right, mode='fast')\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-20"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "combine(right, left, mode='fast')" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_trades_a_starred_argument_like_any_other():
    tree = ast.parse("result = combine(*pair, 9)\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-20"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "combine(9, *pair)" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_identical_arguments_exchange_into_themselves():
    source = "result = combine(same, same)\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-20"].apply(tree) is True
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_twenty_not_applicable_without_a_two_argument_call(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"single.py": SINGLE_SOURCE, "test_single.py": SINGLE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-20"] == NOT_APPLICABLE

    assert _cells(result)["seed-21"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_twenty_one_changes_the_first_character():
    tree = ast.parse('LABEL = "ready"\nOTHER = "xenon"\n')
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-21"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "'xeady'" in rendered
    assert "'zenon'" in rendered
    assert "'ready'" not in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_one_leaves_docstrings_standing():
    source = (
        '"""Module notes."""\n'
        "def f():\n"
        '    """Function notes."""\n'
        '    return "ready"\n'
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-21"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "Module notes." in rendered
    assert "Function notes." in rendered
    assert "'xeady'" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_one_leaves_the_version_literal_standing():
    tree = ast.parse('VERSION = "1.4.2"\nLABEL = "ready"\n')
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-21"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "'1.4.2'" in rendered
    assert "'xeady'" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_one_alters_the_fixed_text_of_a_format_string():
    tree = ast.parse('MSG = f"total is {n} items"\n')
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-21"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "xotal is" in rendered
    assert "xitems" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_one_not_applicable_without_an_in_scope_literal(
    tmp_path,
):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"documented.py": DOCS_SOURCE, "test_documented.py": DOCS_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-21"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_twenty_two_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"offsetting.py": OFFSET_SOURCE, "test_offsetting.py": OFFSET_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-22"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_twenty_two_removes_the_minus_and_keeps_the_operand():
    source = "def adjust(value):\n    return -value\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-22"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "return value" in rendered
    assert "-value" not in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_two_drops_a_nested_negation_once_at_each_level():
    source = "def adjust(value):\n    return --value\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-22"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "return value" in rendered
    assert rendered.count("-") == 0


def test_seed_twenty_two_leaves_unary_plus_and_logical_not_standing():
    source = (
        "def plus(value):\n"
        "    return +value\n"
        "\n"
        "\n"
        "def negate(flag):\n"
        "    return not flag\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-22"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_twenty_two_not_applicable_without_a_negation(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"identity.py": IDENTITY_SOURCE, "test_identity.py": IDENTITY_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-22"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_twenty_three_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"searching.py": SEARCH_SOURCE, "test_searching.py": SEARCH_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-23"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_twenty_three_turns_a_break_into_a_continue():
    source = (
        "def hunt(items):\n"
        "    for item in items:\n"
        "        if item:\n"
        "            break\n"
        "    return None\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-23"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "continue" in rendered
    assert "break" not in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_three_plants_the_inner_loop_break_on_its_own_loop():
    source = (
        "for outer in rows:\n"
        "    for inner in outer:\n"
        "        break\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-23"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "for inner in outer:\n        continue" in rendered
    assert "break" not in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_three_leaves_a_break_outside_a_loop_body_standing():
    source = (
        "def hunt(items):\n"
        "    for item in items:\n"
        "        def helper():\n"
        "            break\n"
        "    while items:\n"
        "        items.pop()\n"
        "    else:\n"
        "        break\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-23"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_twenty_three_not_applicable_without_a_break(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"summing.py": SUM_SOURCE, "test_summing.py": SUM_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-23"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_three_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/3",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:20]],
    }


def test_version_three_pack_still_loads_the_twenty(tmp_path):
    entries = load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, _version_three_data()))
    assert [entry["id"] for entry in entries] == [
        seed.id for seed in SEEDS[:20]
    ]


def test_a_version_four_pack_with_an_invented_id_is_refused(tmp_path):
    data = seed_pack_data()
    data["seeds"][23]["id"] = "seed-99"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ids do not match"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_version_three_pack_carrying_a_grown_registry_id_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    data = _version_three_data()
    data["seeds"][19] = _entry(SEEDS[20])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ids do not match"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, data))


def test_a_pack_whose_count_disagrees_with_version_four_is_refused(
    tmp_path,
):
    twenty_under_v4 = _version_three_data()
    twenty_under_v4["format"] = "canaryfield-seeds/4"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="carries 24"):
        load_seed_pack(_pack_file(tmp_path, twenty_under_v4))
    current_under_v3 = seed_pack_data()
    current_under_v3["format"] = "canaryfield-seeds/3"

"""Slice 9 tests. Four new seeds and a fifth seed pack format.

Every fixture here is synthetic and written for this repo. Each new
seed gets one target where a gate exercising the defect catches it
and one target where its shape is absent and its row reads not
applicable, and the scoping rules each obligation states get a
content level pin each, at the edges as well as the core.
"""

import ast
import json

import pytest

from canaryfield.engine import CAUGHT, NOT_APPLICABLE, run_field
from canaryfield.seedpack import load_seed_pack, seed_pack_data
from canaryfield.seeds import SEEDS, SEEDS_BY_ID

from fixture_project import GATE

ACCUMULATE_SOURCE = """\
def total(values):
    result = 0
    for value in values:
        result += value
    return result
"""

ACCUMULATE_TEST = """\
from accumulating import total


def test_total():
    assert total([1, 2, 3]) == 6
    assert total([]) == 0
"""

SENTINEL_SOURCE = """\
TOKEN = ["key"]


def is_token(value):
    return value is TOKEN
"""

SENTINEL_TEST = """\
from sentinel import TOKEN, is_token


def test_is_token():
    assert is_token(TOKEN) is True
    assert is_token(["key"]) is False
"""

FIRST_SOURCE = """\
def first(items):
    return items[0]
"""

FIRST_TEST = """\
from indexing import first


def test_first():
    assert first(["a", "b"]) == "a"
"""

BOX_SOURCE = """\
def box(width, height):
    return (width, height)


def unit():
    return box(width=1, height=2)
"""

BOX_TEST = """\
from framing import unit


def test_unit():
    assert unit() == (1, 2)
"""

SINGLE_SOURCE = """\
def answer():
    return 42


def show():
    return str(answer())
"""

SINGLE_TEST = """\
from single import answer, show


def test_show():
    assert answer() == 42
    assert show() == "42"
"""


def _write_project(root, files):
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return root


def _cells(result):
    return {row["seed"]: row["gates"]["tests"] for row in result["rows"]}


def _pack_file(tmp_path, data):
    path = tmp_path / "pack.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _entry(seed):
    return {
        "id": seed.id,
        "name": seed.name,
        "defect_class": seed.defect_class,
        "description": seed.description,
    }


def _version_four_data():
    return {
        "format": "canaryfield-seeds/4",
        "seeds": [_entry(seed) for seed in SEEDS[:24]],
    }


def test_seed_twenty_four_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"accumulating.py": ACCUMULATE_SOURCE, "test_accumulating.py": ACCUMULATE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-24"] == CAUGHT


def test_seed_twenty_four_swaps_addition_for_subtraction():
    tree = ast.parse("total += value\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-24"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "total -= value" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_four_swaps_subtraction_and_multiplication_for_addition():
    tree = ast.parse("total -= value\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-24"].apply(tree) is True
    assert "total += value" in ast.unparse(tree)
    tree = ast.parse("total *= value\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-24"].apply(tree) is True
    assert "total += value" in ast.unparse(tree)


def test_seed_twenty_four_plants_every_match_in_one_file():
    source = (
        "def adjust(total):\n"
        "    total += 1\n"
        "    total -= 2\n"
        "    return total\n"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-24"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "total -= 1" in rendered
    assert "total += 2" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_four_plants_onto_a_subscript_target():
    tree = ast.parse("counts[0] += 1\n")
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-24"].apply(tree) is True
    rendered = ast.unparse(tree)
    assert "counts[0] -= 1" in rendered


def test_seed_twenty_four_leaves_an_out_of_table_operator_standing():
    source = "total /= 2\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-24"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))
    source = "total //= 2\n"
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    assert SEEDS_BY_ID["seed-24"].apply(tree) is False
    assert ast.dump(tree) == ast.dump(ast.parse(source))


def test_seed_twenty_four_not_applicable_without_an_augmented_assignment(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"single.py": SINGLE_SOURCE, "test_single.py": SINGLE_TEST},
    )
    result = run_field(target, [GATE], timeout=60)
    assert result["clean_exits"]["tests"] == 0
    assert _cells(result)["seed-24"] == NOT_APPLICABLE


def test_seed_twenty_five_plants_and_is_caught(tmp_path):
    target = _write_project(
        tmp_path / "project",
        {"sentinel.py": SENTINEL_SOURCE, "test_sentinel.py": SENTINEL_TEST},
    )
